title: Hiring: Direct Response Video Editor & AI Creative Producer
description:
Hiring: Direct Response Video Editor & AI Creative Producer



Competitor ad recreation • Long-form VSLs • AI UGC • AI doctors/experts • Cartoon ads • Swedish, Danish & English localization



Read this first



We are not hiring someone whose main goal is to make videos look cinematic or aesthetically pleasing.



We are hiring someone who understands that a paid ad has one job: stop the right person, hold their attention, build belief and make them take action.



You should be able to receive a competitor ad, a script or a rough concept and return a complete, conversion-ready creative. That includes reverse-engineering the reference, finding or generating every necessary visual, producing voiceovers, creating captions, editing the video and delivering finished variations for testing.



If you need us to prepare a folder containing every clip before you can begin, this role is not for you.



If you can independently turn a script or reference ad into a finished ad that feels native, credible and built to sell, keep reading.



Who we are



We are a growing direct-response DTC brand in the health and wellness space. Paid social and creative are central to our growth, and we test both short-form ads and long-form VSLs across Meta and other platforms.



We are building an ongoing creative operation rather than hiring a different freelancer for every project. The goal is to find an editor and AI creative producer who learns our products, customers, winning angles and performance data—and becomes more valuable with every batch we produce.



This starts with a lower, paid project volume so we can evaluate the fit on both sides. If your work performs and the collaboration runs smoothly, the volume, responsibility and compensation will increase. The long-term goal is a stable position with ownership over a large part of our creative pipeline.



What you will actually be doing



1. Reverse-engineering and recreating winning ads



We actively research ads that are working in other markets and for adjacent or competing products. You will often receive a reference ad and be asked to rebuild it for our product and market.



This is not blind copying. Your job is to identify why the original works and preserve those conversion-driving elements while replacing the brand, product, claims, language, visuals and market context.



You must be able to break down and recreate:



The hook and first three seconds



Script structure and sales psychology



Pacing, cuts and pattern interrupts



Visual sequence and shot selection



Demonstrations and mechanism explanations



Proof, testimonials and credibility elements



Captions, on-screen text and callouts



Voiceover style, energy and timing



Music, sound design and emotional shifts



Offer presentation and call to action



Some assignments will require a close, shot-by-shot recreation. Others will require you to preserve the underlying structure while producing an original execution for our brand.



You may receive only the reference ad, product information and a few brand assets. You are expected to solve the rest independently.



2. Localizing ads into Swedish, Danish and English



You will recreate and localize ads for Swedish-, Danish- and English-speaking markets.



Localization does not mean translating every sentence word for word. The finished ad must sound as if it was originally written and produced for that market.



You will be responsible for:



Adapting scripts, hooks and CTAs into natural market-specific language



Preserving the meaning, rhythm and persuasion of the original



Adjusting examples, currency, cultural references and terminology when necessary



Creating or sourcing suitable native-sounding voiceovers



Timing the edit around the localized voiceover rather than forcing a translation into the original timing



Producing accurate subtitles and on-screen text in each language



Flagging awkward or questionable wording before production



Native-level Swedish or Danish is a strong advantage. If you are not fluent, you must have a reliable localization workflow and be comfortable working with approved translations and feedback from native speakers.



3. Producing long-form VSLs



You must be comfortable editing sales videos from approximately 2 to 10+ minutes—not only 15-second social clips.



We provide the script or a proven reference. You turn it into a video that holds attention throughout the entire argument.



That includes:



Mapping a visual plan to every section of the script



Finding or creating enough visual variety to prevent retention from collapsing



Using cuts, zooms, graphics, captions and pattern interrupts intentionally



Visualizing problem and solution mechanisms clearly



Building emotional story sequences rather than placing random stock clips over narration



Introducing the product at the correct point in the story



Showing proof, demonstrations, testimonials, reviews and offer elements credibly



Creating visual callbacks and open loops



Maintaining consistent pacing across several minutes



Delivering different hooks or openings for the same proven body when requested



You need to understand that a long-form VSL cannot feel like a slideshow. Every shot must help explain, prove, intensify or move the story forward.



4. Sourcing footage independently



You will be responsible for finding the footage required by the script.



Sources may include:



Licensed stock libraries



Creator or UGC footage that is cleared for commercial use



Organic social content used as a research reference and then recreated appropriately



Product footage supplied by us



Screen recordings



Public-domain or properly licensed archival footage



AI-generated images and video



Custom graphics, animations and mechanism visualizations



You should know how to research visual references on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and other platforms, identify the exact type of scene the script needs, and then source, license or recreate an appropriate version for commercial use.



You must not simply place random lifestyle clips over a voiceover. If the script says a woman wakes at 2:13 AM, presses the same point near her shoulder blade and opens her laptop, the visuals should communicate that exact moment as convincingly as possible.



5. Generating AI footage and complete AI ads



AI production is a core part of this role, not an occasional bonus.



You must already be able to generate usable commercial footage and know how to fix common AI problems through prompting, reference images, shot design, iteration, compositing, cleanup and upscaling.



Examples of what you may need to create:



Credible doctor, physiotherapist or expert-style presenters



UGC-style customers speaking naturally to camera



Product demonstrations that cannot be filmed practically



Medical or anatomical mechanism visualizations



Before-and-after scenarios without misleading viewers



Consistent characters appearing across multiple scenes



Story-driven scenes in homes, offices, clinics and everyday environments



AI product shots and controlled product placement



Animated explainer sequences



Cartoon and character-led ads



Talking avatars, lip-sync and multilingual versions



Visual metaphors for pain, pressure, stress, sleep or relief



Complete ads produced primarily or entirely with AI



The output cannot look like low-effort AI content. Characters, environments, clothing, product details, lighting and visual style should remain consistent. Motion must feel intentional, and obvious generation errors must be corrected before delivery.



6. Producing UGC, expert, cartoon and other ad formats



We test many formats. You should not be limited to one editing style.



You may be asked to produce:



Native UGC and testimonial-style ads



Doctor or expert advertorial videos



Founder or spokesperson videos



Podcast-style ads



Interview and street-interview concepts



Long-form personal discovery stories



Problem–mechanism–solution VSLs



Listicle and advertorial creatives



AI cartoon stories



Animated explainers



Product demonstration ads



Before-and-after narratives



Short hook-first ads



Static-to-video and image-led ads



Competitor recreations and new variations of existing winners



You should understand how the format changes the viewer's expectations. A native UGC ad should not feel like a polished television commercial, and an expert video should not feel like an obviously fake authority endorsement.



7. Creating captions, graphics, audio and final deliverables



You own the complete post-production process.



This includes:



Accurate subtitles with intentional emphasis



Clean, readable on-screen text for mobile viewers



Kinetic text and callouts where useful



Proper audio levels and voice cleanup



Music and sound design that support the emotional pacing



Colour correction across mixed footage



Removing unwanted text or branding when legally and technically appropriate



Product replacement, tracking and compositing where required



Correct aspect ratios, safe zones, frame rates and export settings



Organized project files and clear version naming



Multiple hooks, CTAs or format variations without rebuilding the entire ad inefficiently



What we need you to understand about direct response



You do not need to be the copywriter, but you must understand the strategy behind the script you are editing.



You should be able to identify:



The target customer and exact problem being called out



The mass desire the ad activates



The problem mechanism: why previous attempts have failed



The solution mechanism: why this approach may work differently



The awareness and sophistication level of the market



The promise, proof, objections and offer



The emotional turning point in the story



Which moments require visual proof rather than generic b-roll



Where retention is likely to drop



Why one hook attracts buyers while another only produces cheap clicks



We want an editor who can challenge a weak visual idea, flag a credibility problem and suggest a stronger way to communicate the same sales point.



Non-negotiable skills



Proven experience editing paid social ads designed to convert



Ability to reverse-engineer and recreate competitor ads accurately



Ability to work from a script or reference without being handed every asset



Strong visual research and independent footage sourcing



Real, current experience with AI image and AI video generation



Ability to maintain character and scene consistency across many AI shots



Ability to edit both short-form ads and long-form VSLs



Strong pacing, storytelling and retention instincts



High-quality subtitles, motion graphics, sound design and audio cleanup



Ability to follow a brief closely while still solving problems independently



Fast and reliable communication



Willingness to receive direct feedback and iterate quickly



Honest use of commercially cleared, licensed, supplied or appropriately generated assets



Ability to follow advertising, disclosure and platform rules: synthetic presenters must never be passed off as real doctors, customers or independent experts, and testimonials, credentials and results must never be fabricated



Ability to deliver organized source files when requested



Tools



You should be highly capable with professional editing software such as:



Adobe Premiere Pro



After Effects



DaVinci Resolve



CapCut Desktop or an equivalent professional workflow



You should also already use several tools in categories such as:



AI video: Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Higgsfield, Hailuo, Seedance or equivalent



AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Ideogram, Nano Banana or equivalent



Voice and lip-sync: ElevenLabs, HeyGen or equivalent



Cleanup and upscaling: Topaz, Magnific or equivalent



Audio restoration: Adobe Podcast, Descript or equivalent



Text and object removal, tracking and compositing tools



We care more about the quality and consistency of your output than the exact tools you use. However, “I am willing to learn AI” is not enough. You should already be producing AI-assisted ads now.



This role is probably not for you if…



You only edit with footage supplied by the client



Your portfolio is mainly cinematic montages, music videos or organic content with no sales objective



You can make a video look good but cannot explain why it should convert



You rely on random stock footage that does not match the script



You use one-click AI outputs without correcting obvious inconsistencies



You cannot recreate the pacing and visual logic of a reference ad



You only produce short-form videos and avoid long-form projects



You disappear for several days when something is unclear



You miss deadlines without warning



You are an agency planning to pass the work to an undisclosed junior editor



We want direct access to the person who will actually create the videos.



How the collaboration starts



The first stage is a paid trial period with a limited number of projects.



Initial assignments will mainly involve:



Recreating and localizing proven competitor ads

title: SaaS Product Explainer Video Editor / Motion Graphics Animator
description:
We are looking for a talented video editor / motion graphics animator to create a polished 60–75 second SaaS product explainer video for Paid360.ai.

Paid360 is an AI-powered accounts receivable platform that connects with QuickBooks and helps businesses identify overdue invoices, prepare customer follow-ups, track promises to pay, disputes, partial payments, and manage the collection process.

This is NOT a generic animated explainer video. We want a premium SaaS-style product demo using our actual software interface as the main visual.

The video will be used when visitors click “See How It Works” on our website.

What we need:

- 60–75 second finished video

- Professional motion graphics and transitions

- Animation of our actual Paid360 dashboard/interface

- Smooth cursor movements, screen zooms, highlights, and UI animations

- Voiceover synchronized with the product demonstration

- Background music and sound design

- Text overlays for important moments

- Ability to subtly animate our AI assistant “Sarah”

- Professional editing suitable for a premium SaaS homepage

- Final versions optimized for website use

The basic story of the video:

1. The Problem

Open with the pain: business owners wasting time chasing customers for overdue invoices.

2. Meet Paid360

Introduce Paid360 as an AI-powered accounts receivable assistant.

3. QuickBooks “Aha” Moment

This is extremely important.

Show the user clicking Connect QuickBooks and then visually show invoices automatically populating inside Paid360.

We want the viewer to immediately understand:

“I don't have to manually enter anything. Paid360 already knows who owes me money.”

Show overdue invoice amounts, days overdue, customer names and total outstanding A/R appearing in the dashboard.

4. Meet Sarah

Show Sarah, our AI assistant, analyzing an overdue invoice and recommending what should happen next.

5. Sarah Creates the Follow-Up

Show Sarah reviewing things such as the outstanding balance, days overdue, payment history, previous communication and customer activity, then preparing an appropriate follow-up
.

6. Major Trust Moment — Human Approval

This is another extremely important part of the video.

Show the message entering a Ready for Approval queue.

Display prominently:

YOU STAY IN CONTROL

Nothing is sent without your approval.

Then show the user reviewing the
 and clicking Approve & Send.

7. Customer Responds

Show examples such as:

- “I'll pay Friday” → Paid360 records Promise to Pay

- “We already paid this” → Needs Review

- Customer disputes invoice → Follow-Up Paused

- Partial payment received → outstanding balance automatically updates

8. Paid360 Keeps Working

Demonstrate that Sarah remembers what happened and updates the plan for each invoice.

9. Results

Return to the dashboard and show recovered money, resolved invoices, promises to pay and declining overdue A/R.

Main message:

Less chasing. More getting paid.

10. Call to Action

Finish with:

Stop chasing invoices. Start getting paid.

Connect QuickBooks Free

No credit card required

Nothing is sent without your approval

Paid360.ai

IMPORTANT STYLE REQUIREMENTS

We want approximately 75–80% of the video to feature the actual Paid360 software interface.

Think modern SaaS companies such as Stripe, Ramp, QuickBooks, HubSpot, etc. — clean, premium, smooth and professional.

We do not want:

- Generic cartoon explainers

- Excessive stock footage

- Cheap-looking AI animation

- A long logo introduction

- A video that attempts to explain every feature

The product itself should sell the product.

Sarah should feel like an intelligent AI employee working inside Paid360, not a cartoon mascot. Any animation of Sarah should be subtle and professional.

We will provide:

- Paid360 logo/branding

- Access/screenshots or screen recordings of the interface

- Sarah character/image

- Full scene-by-scene storyboard

- Voiceover script

- Guidance on which sections of the software should be demonstrated

When applying

Please send 2–3 examples of SaaS product demo/explainer videos you have personally created.

We are especially interested in examples involving:

- UI animation

- SaaS dashboards

- Motion graphics

- Screen recordings

- Product walkthroughs

Please also tell us what software you use (After Effects, Premiere Pro, Figma, Screen Studio, etc.) and your estimated turnaround time.

Do not send generic animation samples. We specifically want to see SaaS/product UI animation work.

There may be significant additional Paid360 video work available for the right person.

title: YouTube Tutorial Video Editor — Fixed-Price Project, 25 Videos (Spreadsheet Template Business)
description:
Hi, I'm Toni! I run TopSheets, a growing digital product business selling spreadsheet templates (Google Sheets + Excel) on Etsy and my own website. I need a video editor to polish a backlog of around 25 tutorial videos into YouTube-ready content.



This is a fixed-price project, not an ongoing weekly role — I have 25 videos that need the same treatment, and once they're done, the project is complete. Work on your own schedule; there's no weekly task list and no fixed hours. You'll be paid per video as you deliver them.



Every video follows the same format, so once you've done one or two, the rest go quickly — this is repetitive, template-driven work, which is exactly why it's priced and delivered per video rather than by the hour.



What You'll Do



- Polish-edit screen-recording tutorial videos (8–20 min finished). I provide a rough cut with the audio, screen recording, and my talking-head footage already synced and mistakes already removed — your job is to make it YouTube-ready

- Add zoom-ins and highlight callouts on the cells/formulas being discussed as I talk through them

- Light text overlays and pacing polish, matching my existing style (examples provided)

- Clean, simple editing style — NO flashy transitions, NO fast-cut effects. Think calm, clear, helpful — this is educational content, not entertainment

- I handle thumbnails, descriptions, and publishing myself — your job ends at the finished long-form export



Requirements



- Proven video editing experience (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar) — portfolio required

- Comfortable following a consistent style guide closely and repeating a process accurately across many videos

- Strong written English (for reading my notes and any on-screen text)

- Reliable internet and a computer that can edit 1080p video smoothly

- Organized: consistent file naming, uses Google Drive, communicates proactively if something is unclear or delayed

- Bonus (not required): experience editing explainer, tutorial, or software-demo videos



Pay & Process



- **Paid test video:** I'll hire a small number of candidates to each edit one video at a fixed price of $15. This lets me see your work firsthand before committing the full batch. The candidate whose edit best fits my style gets the remaining videos in the project.

- **Full project:** $18 per video, paid as each video is delivered and approved, for the remaining ~24 videos.

- **Delivery:** send me each video as soon as it's done rather than batching them up — I'll review and approve (or request changes) before you move on to the next one.

- **Revisions are part of the job.** If I send back edit notes on a video, I expect those changes made and the revised video delivered before it's considered complete and paid. This is normal and expected — most videos will need at least one small revision round, especially early in the project while you're learning my style.

- This is a one-time project. If it goes well, there's a good chance of similar batches in the future as I release new templates, but I want to be upfront that it isn't an ongoing weekly commitment.



How to Apply



1. Start your application with the word **STORYBOARD** so I know you read this posting.

2. Link 3–5 examples of videos you've edited. At least one should be a tutorial, screen-recording, or explainer-style video if you have one. Tell me in one line what YOU did on each (edited only? added graphics? full production?).

3. In 2–3 sentences, tell me: what's one thing that makes a tutorial video easy to follow?

4. Tell me about a time you had to follow someone else's style guide or brand guidelines closely. How did you make sure you got it right?

5. Tell me roughly how many videos per week you could realistically deliver once you're up to speed, so I can plan the project timeline.



Applications that don't follow these steps will not be considered. Thanks, and I'm excited to meet you!

title: Creative VA — Canva Design, Pinterest & Social Content (Digital Template Business)
description:
Hi, I'm Toni! I run TopSheets, a growing digital product business selling spreadsheet templates (Google Sheets + Excel) on Etsy and my own website in four languages. I need a creative VA to handle the recurring design and content work that keeps the business visible: Pinterest pins, listing graphics, and short-form social content.



This is batch, repetitive, template-driven work — you'll get very fast at it. For example, a typical week might be entirely focused on converting one template to the new listing style: creating those listing pages in 3 different color palette variations, then adapting each of those across our 4 language editions (translations provided to you — no translation work required). That's a dozen-plus finished images from one template, all in the new style and following the same layout. If you like production-style creative work where you get faster and more precise the more you do it, this is a great fit.



This is a part-time role built around a weekly task list — I send you the list at the start of the week, you deliver by the end of the week. You choose your own hours. No time tracking, no fixed schedule. I care about finished work, not hours online.



What You'll Do



**Canva / Listing Design (core, repetitive work):**

- Create/upgrade listing image sets for Etsy and my website: device mockups, feature-highlight slides, "what's included" graphics

- Batch-produce color palette variations of the same listing set (e.g., 3 palettes per template)

- Adapt existing graphics into German, Spanish, and French editions — translated text provided by me, you handle the layout

- Update graphics for bundles and seasonal refreshes using existing templates

- **The main project:** I'm upgrading all my existing listing pages to a new style — I have a style guide to work from, and the job is adapting my current listing images into this new style across the whole catalog. Once you've done a couple, it's the same repeatable process for every template. All future listing mockups (new templates, bundles, seasonal updates) will also follow this new style going forward

- **Reference:** browse my current Etsy shop here: 
 to see the current listings (these are what's being upgraded, so treat them as context, not the target). Whatever the new style looks like, it should stay clean and practical, matching a genuine spreadsheet/planner aesthetic — not flashy, trendy, or AI-generated-looking graphics

- You'll work inside a dedicated Canva workspace folder I'll set up and share with you (edit access) — this gives you everything you need, and lets me request small tweaks to existing mockups down the line



**Pinterest:**

- Design pins in Canva using my brand templates (static + video pins)

- Deliver a set number of finished pins each week — I handle scheduling and descriptions myself



**Social media content (growing part of the role):**

- Create short-form reels/TikToks showing our templates in use — aesthetic, satisfying, planner-community style content

- This becomes a bigger share of the weekly list over time



Requirements



- Strong Canva skills — portfolio required

- Comfortable with batch/repetitive production work and keeping variations organized and on-brand

- Detail-oriented: color consistency, correct text swaps across language versions, no leftover placeholder text

- Strong written English

- Reliable internet

- Organized: consistent file naming, uses Google Drive, communicates proactively if something is unclear or delayed

- Bonus (not required): video editing skills for Reels/Shorts, Pinterest marketing experience, or interest in the planner/stationery content niche



Pay & Process



- **Paid trial week:** I will hire 3 candidates for a one-week paid trial ($45 flat). Everyone gets the same task list and reference assets. One person gets the ongoing role.

- **Ongoing:** flat weekly rate of $65/week for approximately 8–10 hours of tasks, paid weekly via [Wise/PayPal/Payoneer].

- Long-term role, with the social media content piece growing over time as we build that side of the business.



How to Apply



1. Start your application with the word **PALETTE** so I know you read this posting.

2. Link a Canva portfolio or 3–5 examples of design work (listing images, social graphics, mockups). Tell me in one line what YOU did on each.

3. Link 1–2 examples of Pinterest pins you've designed, if you have any. Bonus if you can also name the Pinterest profiles you've managed or created for.

4. Link 1–2 examples of short-form vertical content (Reels/TikToks) you've edited, if you have any — not required, but a plus. Bonus if you can also name accounts you've managed or created content for.

5. In 2–3 sentences, tell me: how do you stay organized when producing lots of variations of the same design (different colors, different languages, etc.)?

6. Link one Instagram or TikTok account (any brand) whose short-form content style you love, and tell me in one sentence why.



Applications that don't follow these steps will not be considered. If anything here needs clarification, feel free to ask before applying. Thanks, and I'm excited to meet you!

title: Paid Search Manager
description:
We sell industrial automation components — VFDs, motors, gearboxes, clutches, and brakes — across four websites: three e-commerce stores and one content. Every customer finding us today found us organically. You will be building the paid program from the ground up.



Why this role exists

Our growth has come entirely from organic search and inbound phone quotes. That works, but it caps how fast we can move and leaves us blind to a large pool of buyers searching for parts we stock and can ship the same week.

We are not looking for someone to inherit a mature account and shave 8% off CPCs. We are looking for someone who can stand up measurement, build clean product feeds from our WooCommerce catalogs, prove out paid search with a controlled test budget, and then scale it.



What you will own

First: measurement. GA4 is installed. That is where our instrumentation ends. There is no conversion tracking on orders, forms, or phone calls. You will build all of it — and because a meaningful share of our revenue closes over the phone after a web-sourced quote request, you will need to think seriously about call tracking and offline conversion import, not just checkout events.



Then: the accounts. Google Ads and Shopping across three storefronts, plus whatever role the two content sites play in the funnel. Campaign structure, feed hygiene, negative keyword discipline, bidding strategy, budget allocation across sites.



Ongoing: the number. Paid search here has to clear a target ROAS of roughly 3:1 to be worth scaling. That is the metric you will be measured against. Online orders are the primary conversion; quote requests and calls are a secondary signal we want tracked and valued honestly, not ignored because they are harder to attribute.



Budget: We are starting with a test budget and scaling it against proven returns rather than committing to a fixed monthly spend up front. If you need a large budget on day one to demonstrate value, this is not the right fit. If you like the idea of a budget that grows because you earned it, read on.

ed to

title: MAKE SHOPIFY PRODUCT PAGES  – 1688 & AI EXPERIENCE
description:
SHOPIFY PRODUCT PAGE CREATOR – 1688 & AI EXPERIENCE



Starting Salary: $600 USD/month



Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM



Salary Increase After 3 Months Based on Performance





ABOUT THE POSITION



We are looking for an experienced Shopify Product Page Creator who already knows how to create high-quality Shopify product pages from start to finish.



This is NOT a beginner position.



You must already have at least 3 years of experience creating Shopify product pages.



You must have experience with 1688 and have your own 1688 account.



You must already know how to use AI tools to create and improve product images.



You will be creating approximately 10 complete product pages every day.



We need someone who is extremely careful, organized, detail-oriented, and takes pride in their work.



Someone who looks at every small detail.



Someone who does not rush through pages and create mistakes.



Someone who genuinely enjoys creating product pages and is passionate about making them look professional and accurate.



If you are the type of person who finishes a page and moves on without carefully checking your work, this position is NOT for you.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will receive product information through Google Sheets, including:



• 1688 product link

• Product pricing

• Product category



You will then create the complete Shopify product page.



Your daily responsibilities include:



• Create approximately 10 complete Shopify product pages per day

• Open and work with the provided 1688 products

• Download and organize the correct product images

• Use AI tools to improve and create professional product images

• Make sure AI does NOT change or distort the actual product

• Resize images to 1080 × 1080 pixels

• Create product titles

• Create product descriptions

• Create bullet points

• Create accurate color and size variants

• Add correct pricing

• Organize collections and tags

• Make sure all product information is correct

• Review every page carefully before submitting it





WHAT WE CARE ABOUT MOST



Attention to detail.



This is one of the most important parts of this position.



We need someone who is extremely careful with their work.



Someone who notices small mistakes.



Someone who checks everything twice.



Someone who cares about whether the product image is accurate.



Someone who notices if a color is wrong.



Someone who notices if a size or variant is missing.



Someone who notices spelling, formatting, pricing, images, and product information errors.



We want someone who is almost obsessive about accuracy and quality.



Speed is important, but accuracy comes first.



We would rather have someone who is fast AND extremely careful than someone who is fast but constantly makes mistakes.





AI EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must already have experience using AI tools as part of your product page workflow.



You should be comfortable using tools such as:



• ChatGPT

• Gemini

• AI image generation/editing tools



You need to know how to give AI detailed instructions and how to recognize when an AI-generated image is incorrect.



You should already understand how to create professional product images while keeping the original product accurate.





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You MUST have:



• 3+ years of experience creating Shopify product pages

• Real hands-on Shopify experience

• Experience with Shopify product variants

• Experience with 1688

• Your own 1688 account

• Experience using AI for product images

• Experience creating high-volume product pages

• Ability to create approximately 10 complete pages per day

• Excellent attention to detail

• Excellent organization

• Strong written English

• Ability to work independently





DO NOT APPLY IF



• You have less than 3 years of product page experience

• You have never created Shopify product pages

• You do not have 1688 experience

• You do not have a 1688 account

• You have no experience using AI for product images

• You cannot create approximately 10 pages per day

• You regularly make careless mistakes

• You need constant supervision

• You are not extremely detail-oriented

• You are looking for a beginner position

• You are not interested in staying with a company long term





WE WANT SOMEONE WHO



Takes ownership of their work.



Is extremely organized.



Is very careful.



Pays attention to small details.



Learns quickly.



Learns from mistakes and does not keep making the same mistake.



Takes pride in their work.



Has passion for creating high-quality product pages.



Wants to improve their skills.



Wants to grow with the company long term.



Has a strong work ethic and does not need to be constantly reminded what to do.





APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Please answer EVERY question.



Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.





1. How many years of experience do you personally have creating Shopify product pages?



2. Approximately how many Shopify product pages have you personally created?



3. Do you currently have your own 1688 account? How long have you been using 1688?



4. Explain your exact process for creating a Shopify product page from a 1688 product link.



5. Which AI tools have you personally used to create or improve product images?



6. Give us a real example of how you used AI to create or improve a product image. What did you tell the AI to do?



7. When creating 10 product pages in one day, what do you personally check before submitting each page?



8. Tell us about a mistake you made while creating a product page in the past. What happened, and what did you change afterward so you would not make the same mistake again?



9. If you notice that an AI-generated image has changed the product slightly, what would you do?



10. Why do you believe you are the right person for a position where accuracy, attention to detail, and consistency are extremely important?



11. What makes you passionate about creating product pages?



12. Are you looking for a long-term position where you can grow with the company? Explain.

title: Google Ads + Landing Page + GHL Funnel Specialist
description:
We are looking for someone to take ownership of the digital marketing funnel for an established home theatre and home technology business in Sydney, Australia.



This is NOT just a Google Ads media buyer role.



We need someone who can manage the complete journey:



Google Ads → Landing Page → Form/Phone Lead → CRM → Follow-Up → Qualified Lead → Sale



Our main service is complete custom home cinema builds, generally worth around $10,000–$50,000+, so we care much more about qualified leads and actual sales than cheap clicks or cheap leads.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



Google Ads



* Manage and optimise Google Search campaigns

* Review search terms regularly

* Add negative keywords

* Improve keyword targeting and match types

* Monitor spend, CPC, CTR, conversions and lead quality

* Test headlines, descriptions and offers

* Know when to make changes and when to leave campaigns alone

* Move budget toward campaigns/keywords producing the best opportunities

* Continuously improve traffic quality rather than simply increasing traffic



Landing Pages / Website



* Build and improve landing pages

* Create landing pages for different services/campaigns when required

* Improve conversion rates

* Update website pages, forms, CTAs and content

* Make sure landing pages clearly match the intent of the Google search/ad

* Test different messaging, layouts and offers



Tracking & Attribution



* Set up Google Ads conversion tracking correctly

* Google Tag Manager

* GA4

* Form tracking

* Phone call tracking

* Ensure conversions are not double counted

* Track campaign/keyword/source information into the CRM where possible

* Troubleshoot tracking issues

* Help us understand exactly which marketing is producing qualified leads and sales



GoHighLevel / CRM



* Build and manage pipelines

* Connect website and landing page forms

* Create lead follow-up automations

* SMS/email automations

* Lead notifications

* Capture lead source and campaign attribution

* Help track leads through Qualified → Quote → Won/Lost



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT



Our main KPIs are:



* Qualified Leads

* Cost Per Qualified Lead

* Quotes Generated

* Sales

* Customer Acquisition Cost

* Revenue / ROAS



We still monitor CTR, CPC, conversion rate and CPL, but we do NOT want someone optimising only for cheap clicks or cheap leads.



We want someone who understands the difference between:



Traffic → Lead → Qualified Lead → Sale



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



You should have strong experience with:



* Google Search Ads

* Search term optimisation

* Negative keywords

* Google Tag Manager

* GA4

* Conversion tracking

* Call tracking

* GoHighLevel

* CRM automations

* Landing page creation

* Website/form integrations

* Lead attribution

* Conversion rate optimisation



You need to be proactive.



We do not want someone who checks the account occasionally and sends a generic monthly report.



We want someone who pays attention to the account, regularly reviews what people are actually searching, identifies wasted spend, improves the funnel and communicates what should be changed and why.



TO APPLY



Please answer all of the following:



1. How many years have you managed Google Search Ads?



2. Send examples/screenshots of Google Ads accounts you have managed and explain what you improved.



3. Send examples of landing pages you personally built.



4. Explain your experience with GoHighLevel.



5. Explain how you track:



* Website forms

* Phone calls

* Google Ads leads

* Qualified leads

* Sales



6. A campaign spends $1,000 and generates 10 leads, but none of the leads are qualified. What are the first things you would investigate?



7. Explain the difference between a keyword and a search term in Google Ads.



8. If CTR is strong but very few visitors become leads, what would you investigate?



9. How often do you normally review search terms and make campaign optimisations?



10. What is your hourly/monthly rate and availability?



Please do not send a generic application.



We are specifically looking for someone who understands Google Ads AND the complete funnel after the click.

title: Dispatcher — Fleet Roadside & Mobile Repair Operations
description:
National Fleet Network (NFN) is hiring reliable dispatchers to support our growing roadside and mobile repair network in the United States.



We are looking for 1–2 dispatchers to provide coverage across both daytime and overnight operations.



This role involves coordinating service calls between fleet customers, drivers, technicians, and our internal operations team. You must be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where clear communication, urgency, and good judgment are important.



Pay



$4–$6 USD per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.



Long-term opportunity for strong performers as the company grows.



Available Shifts



We are hiring for:



* Day Shift

* Night / Overnight Shift



Exact schedules will be discussed during the interview.



Applicants should clearly state which shift they are applying for and their availability.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Receiving incoming roadside and fleet service requests

* Gathering accurate vehicle, driver, location, and repair information

* Determining the type of technician or service needed

* Contacting and dispatching available technicians

* Monitoring technician acceptance and ETA

* Keeping customers updated throughout the service call

* Following up with technicians while jobs are in progress

* Escalating urgent or unusual situations appropriately

* Updating job information and notes in our dispatch system

* Coordinating parts or repair information when needed

* Making outbound calls to technicians and customers

* Helping ensure jobs are completed and properly documented

* Maintaining professional communication with fleet customers and technicians



Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is highly preferred:



* Trucking dispatch

* Roadside assistance

* Mobile mechanic dispatch

* Diesel repair

* Automotive repair

* Heavy-duty truck repair

* Fleet maintenance

* Towing dispatch

* Logistics or transportation operations



Automotive or diesel knowledge is a major advantage.



You do not need to be a mechanic, but you should ideally understand common terms such as:



* No-start

* Battery / alternator issues

* Tire failures

* Air leaks

* Brake problems

* Cooling system issues

* Check-engine or fault codes

* Fuel system problems

* Trailer issues

* Preventive maintenance

* Basic automotive and diesel components



Requirements



We are looking for someone who is:



* Highly reliable and punctual

* Comfortable speaking English on the phone

* Able to communicate clearly with U.S.-based customers and technicians

* Calm under pressure

* Organized and detail-oriented

* Comfortable making frequent outbound calls

* Able to manage multiple active service calls at once

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at following procedures

* Able to make reasonable decisions without needing constant supervision

* Comfortable using web-based software and communication tools

* Available consistently for the agreed schedule



You must also have:



* Reliable computer

* Stable high-speed internet

* Quality headset

* Quiet working environment

* Backup internet or mobile data preferred



Important



This is an operations position.



There may be periods when several service calls are active at the same time. We need someone who can stay organized, communicate proactively, and keep jobs moving without waiting to be reminded about every step.



Reliability is extremely important. If you are scheduled to work, we need to know that you will be available and ready to handle calls.

title: Inbound + Outbound Sales Closer (Flawless English Required)
description:
We are Perfect Pear Roof & Exterior Cleaning, a Florida-based exterior cleaning company serving homeowners in the Orlando area. We have been in business since 2006. We are not a call center and we are not a churn-and-burn shop. We sell a recurring maintenance program that keeps homes clean year round, which means our customers stay with us for years and our sales team builds a book of business instead of starting from zero every month.



We are hiring one sales rep. This is a long-term seat on a small team, not a trial gig.



What You Will Actually Do



Inbound:



Answer inbound calls, texts, web form leads, and
 ad leads quickly. Speed to lead is everything here.

Qualify homeowners, understand the property and the problem, and build real rapport in the first 60 seconds.

Quote jobs over the phone and close them on the call whenever possible.

Sell homeowners into our recurring maintenance program rather than one-time cleanings. This is the core of the role.

Book estimates for our field team when a site visit is needed, and confirm those appointments so they hold.



Outbound:



Follow up on every unsold quote until you get a yes or a no. Most of our revenue lives in follow-up.

Work aged and cold lead lists and turn them into booked jobs.

Win-back calls to past customers who have not been serviced in a while.

Upsell and cross-sell existing customers into additional services and higher tier plans.

Outbound calls into target neighborhoods and referral sources.



Every Day:



Log every call, note, and next step in our CRM [CRM name]. If it is not in the CRM, it did not happen.

Keep your pipeline clean and current.

Submit a short daily check-in with your numbers: dials, contacts, quotes, closes, revenue.

Hit weekly and monthly targets that we will set together and review every week.

Follow our scripts and objection frameworks, then help us make them better.



Who We Are Looking For



A closer. You have sold over the phone before and you can tell me your numbers: close rate, average ticket, monthly revenue closed. Vague answers will not get you an interview.

Flawless spoken English. Clear, neutral, confident, easy for an American homeowner to understand with zero effort. This is non-negotiable.

Two or more years in phone sales, appointment setting, or account management. Home services, pest control, HVAC, roofing, or subscription sales experience is a big plus.

Thick skin and high energy. You will hear no a lot and it will not slow you down.

Comfortable working US Eastern Time hours.

Quiet, dedicated home office. No background noise, no roosters, no family in the room. Reliable high-speed internet, a quality headset, and a backup internet source and power plan.

CRM literate and organized. You never lose a lead.

Coachable and competitive. You want to be measured and you want to win.



Compensation



$600 per month plus commission on everything you close. Top performers here earn well above base. We pay on time, every time. We use Wise. We have 2 other va's that work with us. 



Hours: [8 -5pm , US Eastern Time]



How To Apply (Read Carefully)



Applications that skip any of these steps will be deleted without a reply. No exceptions.



1. Start your message with the word PEARS so I know you read the entire ad.

2. Attach or link an audio recording of yourself speaking, 60 to 90 seconds, in one take, no script reading. In the recording, tell me:

     a. Your name and where you are located.

     b. The single best sale you ever closed and how you closed it.

     c. Then handle this objection out loud as if I am the homeowner: "Your price is higher than the other two guys who quoted me."

You can record at 
 and paste the link, or upload the file directly. If there is no audio recording, your application gets deleted. I will not ask you for it.

3. In your written message, give me your actual sales numbers from your last role: close rate, average deal size, and monthly revenue closed.

4. Tell me in one sentence why selling a recurring service is different from selling a one-time job.



If you are the person I am looking for, this will take you fifteen minutes and you will enjoy doing it.

title: Sales and Customer Service Virtual Assistant | GoHighLevel Experience Required
description:
Teddy Prestige Detail Stop is a growing mobile detailing company based in York, Pennsylvania, backed by more than 250 five star Google reviews. We help busy individuals, families, and businesses keep their vehicles clean and protected without the inconvenience of visiting a shop.



We are looking for a dependable, proactive virtual assistant to take ownership of daily customer communication, sales follow ups, and administrative responsibilities so the owner can focus on growing the business.



This is not simply a data entry position. You must be comfortable answering calls, speaking with American customers, explaining services, following up with leads, and helping turn inquiries into booked appointments.



What you will do



Customer service and sales



Answer incoming phone calls, return missed calls, and respond to customer texts,
s, and inquiries. Ask the right questions to understand each customer’s vehicle, needs, and expectations. Explain our services and recommend appropriate packages using our approved pricing and procedures.



Confidently handle common objections, including pricing questions, without being pushy. Follow up with customers who have not responded, accepted an estimate, or completed their booking. Keep conversations friendly, professional, and personalized.



Estimates, appointments, and customer care



Prepare and send estimates through OrbisX using our established packages and guidelines. Check existing records before creating duplicate leads or estimates.



Help customers review their options, accept estimates, complete the deposit process, and schedule appointments. Manage appointment confirmations, reminders, and scheduling changes through our existing process.



Coordinate with the owner and detailing team so customers receive accurate updates. Follow up after completed services, request honest reviews, introduce maintenance options, and bring customer concerns to the owner’s attention promptly.



GoHighLevel and business organization



Use GoHighLevel daily to manage leads, conversations, opportunities, pipelines, tasks, and follow ups. Keep customer information, notes, lead sources, opportunity stages, and values accurate.



Understand and maintain the separation between our systems: GoHighLevel handles leads and marketing, OrbisX handles detailing estimates and bookings, and Square handles payment processing.



Follow our existing workflows and procedures. Do not make major system changes, change pricing, or promise discounts without approval.



Provide a clear daily summary of new leads, estimates sent, appointments booked, outstanding follow ups, and anything requiring the owner’s attention.



Social media and business outreach



Help prepare and publish social media content using our photos, videos, brand voice, and approved messaging. Post in relevant local
 groups while following each group’s rules. Respond to comments and messages and direct interested customers into our sales process.



Research potential fleet and commercial clients, organize contact information, and assist with personalized outreach and follow ups.



Support other related administrative tasks as the business grows.



Required qualifications



Previous hands on GoHighLevel experience is required. You should already be comfortable working with conversations, opportunities, pipelines, contact records, and follow up tasks.



You must have strong spoken and written English and be comfortable handling customer calls. Previous experience in sales, customer service, appointment setting, or lead follow up is required.



We need someone who is organized, pays attention to details, follows through on tasks, and communicates proactively rather than waiting to be reminded.



You must have a reliable computer, stable internet connection, a headset, and a quiet workspace suitable for customer calls.



Availability during United States Eastern Time business hours is required. Please apply only if you can consistently work the agreed schedule.



Experience supporting a detailing company, automotive business, or home service company is a plus. OrbisX experience is helpful but not required if you can learn our system.



Compensation and schedule



Pay is $300 to $400 USD per week, depending on experience and qualifications.



The planned schedule is 40 hours per week. Exact working hours and days will be discussed during the interview.



We are looking for someone interested in a long term role who takes pride in helping customers and keeping a business organized.



How to apply



Start your application with “Teddy VA.”



Include your resume, a brief explanation of your GoHighLevel experience, and examples of your sales or customer service responsibilities.



Provide a 60 to 90 second voice introduction so we can hear how you communicate with customers. Include your availability in Eastern Time, your expected weekly pay within the advertised range, and your earliest start date.



Finally, answer this question:



A customer received an estimate and replies, “Another company is cheaper. Why should I book with you?” What would you say?

title: Creative Strategist / Editor
description:
We’re looking for someone who sits between creative strategy and editing.



You’ll work mainly with influencer and UGC footage, turning raw content into high-performing paid ads. The editing itself isn’t overly complex - what matters is understanding hooks, pacing, angles, customer psychology, and what actually makes someone stop scrolling and buy.



What you’ll do

Edit influencer / creator footage into direct-response ads

Rework existing footage into stronger hooks, angles and variations

Come up with your own creative ideas instead of just following briefs

Understand the customer deeply and know what messaging and visuals resonate

Review performance data and iterate quickly on winners

Work with voiceovers and new formats when relevant



You will not have an editor under you. You own both the thinking and the execution.



How we work



We move fast.



You won’t wait days for feedback or approvals. We review creative quickly, launch new ads fast, and give you direct feedback based on real performance.



If an idea is good, we test it. If something works, we iterate on it immediately.



Who we want

Strong editing skills

Good understanding of direct-response creative

Performance-minded — you care about what spends and converts, not just what looks good

Fast, reliable and comfortable with direct feedback

Someone who naturally goes the extra mile and improves things without being asked

Fashion / apparel experience is a strong plus

Compensation



$1,500–$2,000/month base + uncapped bonuses tied to winning ads and performance.



If your creative drives results, you’ll be rewarded accordingly.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become exceptionally good at performance creative and grow with the role.

title: Operations Integrator / Manager
description:
Operations Integrator / Operations Manager

Location: Remote

Type: part-time (hours est 15-20 hours per week with room to grow)

Reports to: COO



About the Role

We’re looking for an Operations Integrator to sit between our COO and support team and keep the backend of our fast-paced Australian business running smoothly.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role for someone who can take priorities, solve problems, improve systems and automations, and get things done.



You’ll oversee day-to-day operations, optimise processes, manage technology and automation, and work closely with the COO and support team to keep the business moving. At times, some people management responsibilities of our support team will be required. 



Core Responsibilities

- Own the day-to-day | Work with our support team to deliver across programs, events, products and services

- Process Optimisation | Build, document and improve SOPs and workflows with an automation, human-first mindset

- Technology & Automation | Manage platforms, build automations and funnels, and develop practical tech solutions. You will own our tech stack

- Problem Solving | Identify issues, think critically and implement solutions alongside the COO, without needing step-by-step direction

- Execution | Turn priorities into action quickly, efficiently and with strong attention to detail

- Communication | Communicate clearly and proactively across the CEO, COO, and wider business

- Continuous Improvement | Constantly identify opportunities to make the business more efficient, scalable and effective



What This Role Is

Essentially, you’re an Integrator.

> You’ll take high-level priorities from the COO and turn them into execution. You’ll execute on tasks, solve problems, improve systems and make sure things actually happen.

> You’ll have the autonomy to work out how something should be done, rather than simply being given a list of steps to follow.



 We’re looking for someone who is:

 > Systems and process driven

 > Highly organised and detail-oriented

> Tech-savvy and comfortable with automations, funnels and backend systems

> Experienced building automated flows in native systems, but also with connectors (
 etc)

> Solutions-focused and proactive

> A strong communicator

> Comfortable working independently

> Fast-moving and adaptable



What This Role Is NOT

>This is not an EA or general support role.

>We don’t need someone who simply follows SOPs or waits for instructions. You won’t need to manage calendars or triage inboxes (we have good people handling this), but you will need to be comfortable moving through a variety of tasks.



What Success Looks Like aka You’ll know you’re succeeding when:

> The COO can delegate a priority and trust you to run with it

> The support team has clarity and things get done

> Problems are identified and resolved quickly

> Processes are continually becoming simpler and more efficient

> Manual work is being automated wherever possible

> Technology and systems run smoothly behind the scenes

> The business is becoming easier to operate and scale



If you think you're a good fit, but don't meet 100% of the skills listed, we encourage you to still apply. Tell us what your zone of genius is and how you'll grow into the role.

title: Ecommerce Customer Service Representative (Shopify)
description:
PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a fast-growing 7-figure DTC eCommerce brand looking for an experienced and exceptional Customer Service Representative to join our team.



This isn't just another customer service job.



We're looking for someone who is driven, adaptable, proactive, and genuinely excited to grow with a company long-term.



We value attitude, work ethic, and the willingness to improve. However, applicants must already have a strong foundation in e-commerce customer service and hands-on experience with the tools required for this role.



IMPORTANT: STRICT EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS



Please read the following requirements carefully before applying.



These are NON-NEGOTIABLE requirements.



1. HANDS-ON SHOPIFY EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



Applicants must have previous hands-on experience using Shopify in an e-commerce customer service role.



You should be comfortable navigating Shopify, reviewing orders, checking customer and order details, and handling basic e-commerce-related tasks.



If you have never used Shopify before, please DO NOT APPLY.



2. PREVIOUS E-COMMERCE CUSTOMER SERVICE EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must have previous experience working in e-commerce customer service.



We are no longer accepting applicants without prior e-commerce customer service experience.



This role requires individuals who already understand the fundamentals of handling customer inquiries, order concerns, refunds, replacements, shipping issues, and other common e-commerce support scenarios.



If you have no previous e-commerce customer service experience, please DO NOT APPLY.



3. EXPERIENCE WITH AT LEAST ONE CUSTOMER SERVICE PLATFORM IS REQUIRED



You must have hands-on experience using at least ONE of the following customer service or helpdesk platforms:



- Richpanel

- CommsLayer

- Front

- Zendesk

- Gorgias



You should have actual experience using the platform to handle customer inquiries or manage customer support tickets.



Experience with other comparable helpdesk or customer service platforms may also be considered, provided you have genuinely used the platform in a customer support role.



If you have no experience using ANY of the platforms listed above, or any comparable customer service helpdesk platform, please DO NOT APPLY.



AUTOMATIC DISQUALIFICATION



To respect everyone's time, please do not apply if you do not meet the minimum experience requirements outlined above.



Applicants who do not have:



- Hands-on Shopify experience

- Previous e-commerce customer service experience

- Experience using at least one of the required customer service platforms or a comparable helpdesk system



will be automatically declined.



We are looking for experienced candidates who can adapt to our workflows, follow our SOPs, and contribute to the team without requiring training on the fundamentals of e-commerce customer service.



Please be honest about your experience. We value transparency and would rather work with someone who accurately represents their skills and background.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for someone who:



- Has excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and communication skills.

- Has proven experience working in e-commerce customer service.

- Is confident navigating Shopify and customer service platforms.

- Learns quickly and enjoys mastering new systems and processes.

- Is proactive and takes initiative instead of waiting to be told what to do.

- Can work independently with minimal supervision.

- Is resourceful and knows how to find answers before asking for help.

- Accepts feedback professionally and applies it immediately.

- Is adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where processes continue to improve.

- Is willing to unlearn habits from previous companies and fully adopt our workflows, SOPs, and standards.

- Takes pride in producing high-quality work instead of simply completing a shift.

- Is looking for a long-term opportunity rather than just another VA job.

- Can commit to being fully focused and productive during scheduled working hours.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



The following experience is a plus and will be considered an advantage:



- Experience handling subscription-based e-commerce businesses.

- Experience navigating or using Loop Subscriptions.

- Experience with Checkout Champ.

- Experience with other subscription management platforms.

- Familiarity with subscription cancellations, billing inquiries, subscription modifications, and recurring order management.

- Experience working with multiple e-commerce tools and systems.



These are preferred qualifications, not strict requirements. However, candidates with relevant subscription management experience may be better prepared for some of the responsibilities of this role.



RESPONSIBILITIES



You'll be responsible for:



- Responding to customer
s professionally and empathetically.

- Resolving customer concerns efficiently and accurately.

- Handling order updates, shipping inquiries, refunds, replacements, and product questions.

- Assisting customers with subscription-related concerns, including cancellations, billing questions, and subscription changes.

- Navigating Shopify and relevant customer service systems to investigate and resolve customer issues.

- Following company SOPs while adapting to new processes as the business grows.

- Documenting and managing customer interactions accurately.

- Escalating complex issues when necessary.

- Delivering a consistently excellent customer experience.

- Maintaining high standards of quality, accuracy, and professionalism.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH



- Starting rate: $4 USD/hour.

- New hires will begin on a part-time trial period.

- High-performing team members who consistently demonstrate reliability, initiative, and strong performance will have the opportunity to transition into a full-time position (40–48 hours/week).

- Performance bonuses may be available based on company policies and individual performance. (KPIs)

- Opportunities for additional responsibilities and career growth as the company continues to expand.



We're looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with the company.



Preference will be given to applicants who can make our team their primary work commitment. Applicants with other part-time jobs or client commitments may still be considered, provided they fully disclose these commitments during the application process.



If you currently work with another employer or client, please include the following information in your application:

-Your preferred working schedule with us.

-The days and hours you currently work for your other employer or client.

-Your availability outside of those working hours.



This information will help us assess your availability and determine potential scheduling arrangements if you progress through the interview process.



Please be honest and transparent about your current work commitments. Full disclosure is important to us when evaluating candidates for long-term opportunities with our team.



OUR HIRING PROCESS



We invest heavily in building a strong team, so our hiring process is designed to identify candidates who are willing to learn, follow instructions, and grow with the company.



1. Submit your application.

2. Selected applicants will receive a short application form.

3. Top candidates will be invited for an interview.

4. Successful interviewees will receive access to our learning materials for a self-paced learning period (approximately one week).

5. Before the end of that week, you'll complete a timed mock customer support assessment based on the materials provided.

6. Candidates who successfully pass the assessment will proceed to the paid training stage, with the opportunity to become a long-term member of our team.



Please note:



The evaluation stage is designed to assess your ability to learn, follow SOPs, and apply new knowledge to real-world customer support scenarios.



Only candidates who successfully pass the evaluation stage will move on to paid training.



REQUIREMENTS



- At least 18 years old.

- Fluent in written English.

- Strong grammar, spelling, and communication skills.

- Previous hands-on Shopify experience.

- Previous e-commerce customer service experience.

- Hands-on experience using at least one of the required customer service platforms listed in this post, or a comparable helpdesk system.

- Reliable computer and internet connection.

- Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Willingness to learn and continuously improve.

- Ability to follow company SOPs and adapt to changing workflows.

- Strong problem-solving skills.



HOW TO APPLY



To confirm that you've read this entire job post, please follow all the instructions below.



1. Include the word PURPLE at the beginning of your application title.



2. Answer the following questions:



- How many years of e-commerce customer service experience do you have?

- How long have you been using Shopify? Briefly describe the tasks you regularly handled in Shopify.

- Which customer service or helpdesk platforms have you used? Please list all the platforms you have hands-on experience with and describe how you used them.

- Have you worked with subscription-based e-commerce businesses? If yes, which subscription platforms have you used?

- What motivates you to do great work?

- Why do you want to work with our company?

- How do you usually handle constructive feedback?

- If you don't know the answer to a customer's question, what would you do?



3. BONUS EXERCISE



A customer sends the following
:



"I've already
ed twice and nobody has helped me. This is honestly very frustrating."



Write the response you would send to this customer.



4. EXPERIENCE VERIFICATION



Please include the following information in your application:



- Your previous e-commerce customer service experience.

- The Shopify stores or types of e-commerce businesses you have worked with.

- The customer service platforms you have used.

- The subscription management tools you have experience with, if any.



Please do not share confidential information from previous employers.



We carefully review every application.



Thoughtful answers, genuine hands-on experience, and attention to detail matter much more than generic responses or years of experience alone.



If you meet all the strict requirements and are confident in your ability to deliver high-quality customer service, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing & Client Relations Assistant | Work From Home
description:
Remote Marketing Assistant / Personal Assistant & Client Relations

Work From Home Philippines | Work on-site Netherlands



A dedicated marketing and sales role for women who want more from life.



MailWorkers.eu is looking for confident, ambitious women who want something different from the usual. 



Maybe you’ve been waiting for the right opportunity to show what you got and you feel ready to take on a bigger challenge, one that gives you more fulfillment and a real chance to discover yourself and just how far you’re willing to go.



You’ll start with a 1-month paid work training as part of our Outreach Team.



You’ll receive training and guidance, work on real assignments, communicate with potential clients, use social media, join video meetings and have the opportunity to show us what you can do.



No experience? That’s okay.



If you’re smart, curious and coachable, we’ll teach you what you need.





Qualifications we look for:



• Confident and comfortable in your own skin

• Naturally engaging and comfortable in front of a camera

• Able to hold a conversation and keep it interesting

• Good at making people feel comfortable talking to you

• Socially intelligent and able to read between the lines

• Able to pick up on tone, mood and what someone really means

• Persuasive without sounding pushy or scripted

• Quick-thinking and able to respond naturally when a conversation goes somewhere unexpected

• Curious about people and genuinely interested in getting to know them

• Independent enough to take initiative without needing instructions for every little thing

• Reliable, discreet and able to handle responsibility

• Fluent or highly comfortable communicating in English



Experience in livestreaming, content creation, social media, customer relations, hospitality, sales, online selling or similar people-facing work is an advantage.



But personality, confidence and potential matter more to us than qualifications on paper.



You’ll start with outreach and growth.



You’ll help us find interesting companies and people, create personalized outreach, start conversations and build new relationships.



This is also where we get to know you.



How you communicate. How you think. How you connect with people. How you handle responsibility. And what happens when we give you room to show your personality and take initiative.



What happens if you prove yourself?



Outreach is where you start. It doesn’t have to be where you finish.



As you gain experience, other opportunities may open within the company.



For some, that could mean sales or client relations.



For others, it could mean progressing into a Dedicated Special Assistant or Private Assistant role, working one-to-one with selected European clients.



These roles can be much more personal and varied than a normal VA position.



You could help with communication, research, personal tasks, special projects and one-to-one video calls.



Sometimes a client may simply want an intelligent, interesting person they enjoy talking to, exchanging ideas with and having around.



Every client is different. So is every assignment.



That’s why personality matters.



We’re looking for women who understand people, can read between the lines and are comfortable being themselves.



Bring your personality. Bring your confidence. Show us what makes you different.



Where could it lead?



Strong performers may be offered longer-term opportunities, greater responsibility and higher compensation.



For the right person, there may eventually be an opportunity to relocate to the Netherlands and work with us in Amsterdam.



It isn’t promised.



It’s something you earn.



There may be an opportunity much bigger than you imagined sitting right in front of you. You just have to reach for it.



If you think you have what it takes, send your CV, a few recent pictures and a short personal introduction.



Send it directly to Founder & Owner :  



MailWorkers.eu



Because people trust people.

title: MARKETING ASSISTANT (SLIMEATORY)
description:
About Us



Slimeatory is a fast-growing creative brand known for our handcrafted slime products, interactive experiences, and high-performing digital content. Backed by major creators and a highly engaged audience, we focus on marketing that doesn’t just look good—but drives real growth, engagement, and sales.



Overview

We are looking for a Marketing Assistant who understands how to execute, analyze, and improve marketing efforts across multiple channels—not someone who just posts content or follows instructions.



This role is for someone who can think strategically, act on data, and contribute to real business growth. You should understand how marketing efforts translate into traffic, engagement, and revenue, and be able to continuously improve results.



Key Responsibilities

Content & Campaign Execution (Core Focus)

• Plan, create, and execute marketing content across social media, email, and other platforms

• Ensure all content is aligned with brand goals and optimized for performance

• Identify high-performing formats, hooks, and trends—and replicate them effectively



Growth & Strategy

• Support and develop strategies to increase brand awareness, engagement, and sales

• Understand how different platforms and channels contribute to growth

• Actively look for opportunities to improve campaigns, not just maintain them



Analytics & Optimization

• Track and analyze performance across campaigns (engagement, reach, conversions)

• Identify what’s working and scale it

• Quickly adjust or eliminate underperforming efforts



Marketing Support & Execution

• Assist in product launches, promotions, and campaign rollouts

• Support marketing operations including content planning, coordination, and execution

• Work closely with the team to ensure consistency and performance across all marketing efforts



Requirements

• 2+ years of experience in marketing, social media, or digital marketing

• Proven ability to contribute to growth, engagement, or conversions

• Strong understanding of content performance, especially short-form content

• Ability to analyze data and make informed decisions

• Proactive, self-sufficient, and results-driven



What We're NOT Looking For

• Someone who only schedules or uploads content

• Basic graphic design without understanding performance

• No experience with analytics, strategy, or growth



Bonus Skills

• Experience with paid ads (Meta, TikTok, Google)

• Strong video editing skills for short-form content

• Understanding of marketing funnels (awareness ? engagement ? conversion)

• Experience in e-commerce or product-based brands



Who This Role is For

• Someone who can answer:

“How do we improve this campaign to get better results?”

• Someone who takes ownership of outcomes—not just tasks

• Someone focused on performance, growth, and execution



If you have real experience in marketing and can show measurable results, we’d love to hear from you.

 and Phone Management
