title: Remote Outbound Caller – US Real Estate (Novation Agents)
description:
About Us

We are launching a new US platform that connects novation-friendly real estate agents with verified real estate investors. Investors post their deals directly on the platform, and agents log in and choose the deals that fit their market and business. No cold chasing, no middlemen, just real deals from verified investors, ready for an agent to list.



We are backed by an active US real estate investment company operating in about 10 states, and we are now building our agent network nationwide.



The Role

You will call US real estate agents who already work with novation deals (or are open to them), have a short professional conversation, ask a few qualifying questions, and introduce them to our platform. Your goal is to get them to sign up and understand how the platform works.



What You Will Do



Working Monday - Friday 9am est - 5pm est (include 1 hour break) 

Make outbound calls to real estate agents across the US from a lead list we provide

Ask qualifying questions, for example:

Have you worked on novation deals before? How many in the last 12 months?

Which areas or counties do you cover?

What price range and property types do you usually work with?

How do you currently get deals from investors?

Explain the platform simply: investors upload deals, agents choose the deals they want, everyone works with verified partners

Book agents for sign-up or a short follow-up call when needed

Log every call, answer, and outcome in our CRM

Report daily numbers (calls, conversations, sign-ups)



Must Have



Experience in US real estate: dispositions, acquisitions, cold calling for investors, or working with US agents

Understanding of how wholesaling and novation deals work (or strong real estate basics and fast learning)

Clear, neutral English with no strong accent. US agents must feel comfortable talking to you

Self-managed and reliable. We don't want to check on you all day. You know what needs to be done and you do it

Stable internet, quiet workspace, good headset

Available to work US business hours



Nice to Have



Experience with CRMs (GoHighLevel, Podio, or similar) and dialers

Experience talking with real estate agents specifically

Experience with a startup or new product launch



How to Apply

Send the following:



Your resume with your US real estate experience clearly listed

A 2-minute voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your US real estate experience

Your daily availability (in US Eastern Time)

Start your application with the words "Agent Network" so we know you read the full post



Applications without the voice recording will not be reviewed.

title: Content Marketer With Video Editing Skills
description:
## About Us  

We are a fast-growing social media and content marketing agency that helps brands, podcasts, and founders turn attention into leads. Our work spans podcast repurposing, short-form video, social media growth, newsletters, and full-funnel content systems.



This is not a traditional video editor role.



We are looking for someone who understands content first and editing second. Someone who has worked in social media, understands why content performs, and uses editing as a tool to make ideas land harder.



If your strength is fancy transitions or cinematic effects, this role is not a fit. If your strength is knowing what to clip, how to frame it, and why someone would stop scrolling, keep reading.



##The Role



Think of this role as a content marketer who edits.



You will be responsible for shaping raw conversations into short-form content that performs. That means d
 what moments matter, how they should be framed, and how to edit them so the message is clear, engaging, and watchable.



Editing skills are required. Content judgment matters more. 



## What You’ll Do  

- Watch and listen to long-form content to identify moments worth turning into clips.

- D
 what should be edited, not just how it should be edited.

- Turn raw conversations into clear, compelling short-form content people actually want to watch.

- Shape clips using pacing, framing, and structure rather than heavy effects.

- Create strong hooks in the first few seconds using insight, context, or contrast.

- Improve clips by tightening the message, sharpening the point, or reframing the moment.

- Research what works for different audiences and platforms to guide clip selection and structure.

- Work closely with our strategy team to align content with growth and marketing goals.



## What We’re Looking For  

- Proven experience editing for social media (please share examples/portfolio).  

- Ability to identify and create viral hooks.

- Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, and emotional engagement.  

- Knowledge of current social media trends and platform-specific best practices.  

- Research-driven: knows how to study an audience, industry, or trend to inform edits.  

- Proficiency in video editing software (Premiere Pro is preferred).  

- Bonus: experience with motion graphics, memes, or creative overlays.  



## Who You Are  

- Ability to think critically about content and suggest better angles or moments.

- Creative and curious, always testing new styles and approaches.  

- A strong sense of taste. You can recognize a great moment instantly.

- Detail-oriented but fast, balancing quality with turnaround time.  

- Understanding of storytelling, attention, and audience behavior.

- Flexible in editing style, able to adjust for different clients and audiences.  

- Proficiency in Premiere Pro or similar tools.

- Experience editing for social media, with examples that show good judgment, not just clean edits.



##Who You Are

-You care more about whether a clip is worth watching than how polished it looks.

-You naturally think in hooks, moments, and angles.

-You see editing as a form of storytelling and decision-making, not just technical execution.

-You are confident enough to say, “This part won’t work, but this one will.”

-You understand that good content beats perfect edits.



## Why Join Us  

- Work with a team that values creativity and results.  

- Get exposure to a variety of clients and industries.  

- Grow with a company that is scaling quickly in social media and digital marketing.  

- Remote, flexible work with opportunity for long-term growth.  



## How to Apply  

Send examples of short-form content you have worked on and a short explanation of why you chose those moments. We care more about your thinking than your effects. Applications without examples or notes will not be reviewed

I am hiring MORE THAN ONE editor. I run videos in parallel instead of stacking them on one person, so nobody gets rushed.



THE WORK

title: Creative Strategist – Full Time – 8-Figure Ecom Brands
description:
We’re looking for a Creative Strategist who understands WHY people buy.



Not someone who just scrolls the
 Ads Library, copies competitors, and calls it research.



We run multiple 8-figure DTC brands in the US and are building an internal creative team focused on producing high-performing direct-response advertising at scale.



Your job is simple:



Understand the customer → find the right message → turn it into ads that sell.



You’ll work closely with our editors and media buyers to research customers, develop new angles and concepts, analyze performance, and continuously find new ways to communicate our products.



What you'll be doing:



Researching customers, competitors, reviews, Reddit, forums and the wider market

Finding new desires, pain points, objections and emotional triggers

Developing new angles, hooks and creative concepts

Writing scripts and detailed creative briefs

Analyzing winning and losing ads to understand WHY they performed

Turning learnings from winners into new iterations and concepts

Guiding video editors and giving clear creative direction

Working closely with media buyers to understand performance

Developing ideas across UGC, storytelling, advertorial, cinematic and other formats

Helping us build a repeatable system for finding winning creatives

What We're Looking For



You need at least 1 year of experience in creative strategy, direct-response marketing, or a closely related role.



But we value character, work ethic, curiosity and your ability to think more than years of experience.



You should understand:



Eugene Schwartz's 5 Stages of Awareness

Market Sophistication

Customer desires and mass desires

Hooks, angles and mechanisms

Direct-response copywriting

Customer research

Creative testing and iteration



If you don't know Breakthrough Advertising by Eugene Schwartz, please don't apply.



We don't expect you to know everything. We do expect you to be obsessed with learning and getting better.



We're looking for someone who constantly asks why.



Why did this hook work?



Why did people respond to this angle?



Why did this ad spend $100,000 while another died at $500?



Why does this customer actually want our product?



That's the type of thinking we want on our team.



Compensation



Base salary starts at $2,000/month + 3% of the ad spend generated by your winning creatives.



If you're already highly skilled and can prove it, we're open to discussing a higher base salary.



We want your incentives aligned with ours: the better your creatives perform and the more we can scale them, the more you earn.



You'll also get access to weekly training, mentorship, our internal learnings, and all the tools you need to perform at a high level.



This is a full-time, long-term position working directly with brands doing $1M+ per month.



TO APPLY, SEND US:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your experience

2. Brands you've worked with

3. 3–5 winning ads/concepts you've personally strategized and their results

4. Your favorite lesson from Breakthrough Advertising and how you've applied it



Please don't send us a generic AI-written application.



We're looking for someone hungry, reliable and genuinely interested in becoming world-class at creative strategy.

title: CUSTOMER SERVICE SPECIALIST – SHOPIFY APPAREL / E-COMMERCE
description:
CUSTOMER SERVICE SPECIALIST – SHOPIFY APPAREL / E-COMMERCE



Starting Salary: $600 USD/month



Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM



Salary Increase After 3 Months Based on Performance





ABOUT THE POSITION



We are looking for an experienced Customer Service Specialist who has worked directly with Shopify apparel/e-commerce brands.



This is NOT a general customer service position.



We are NOT looking for someone who has only worked in call centers, restaurants, hotels, telecommunications, or other types of customer service.



You must already have real experience working inside Shopify stores and handling the specific type of customer service described below.



You must have a minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience.



If you do not have experience with these exact requirements, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You MUST have hands-on experience with:



• Shopify stores

• Shopify apparel/e-commerce brands

• Gmail

• Returns and refunds directly inside Shopify

• Shopify order management

• Shopify order notes

• Unfulfilled orders

• Tracking numbers

• Tracking synchronization issues

• Working with sourcing agents for orders problematics 

• Customer complaints

• Refund requests by customers 

• Replacement requests by customers 

• Chargebacks

• Commslayer app (IS A MOST)





COMMSLAYER EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must already have hands-on experience using Commslayer.



You need to understand how the app works and how to properly organize customer conversations inside the system.



You should understand the different functionalities available inside Commslayer, including its AI capabilities.



You must already know how to use the system efficiently.



If you have never worked with Commslayer, DO NOT APPLY.



We are looking for someone who already knows the software and can start working without basic training.





SHOPIFY EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must already know how to work directly inside Shopify.



You should be comfortable handling situations such as:



• Customer requests a refund

• Customer requests a replacement

• Customer says an order has not arrived

• Order is showing as unfulfilled

• Tracking number is missing

• Tracking number did not synchronize from the sourcing agent

• Tracking information is incorrect

• Customer received the wrong product

• Customer received the wrong size or color

• Product is damaged

• Customer wants to return a product

• Customer claims they never received the package



You should already understand what actions need to be taken inside Shopify and how to document important changes using order notes.





CUSTOMER SERVICE + COMPANY FINANCIALS



This is extremely important.



We do NOT want someone who simply gives the customer whatever they ask for.



We want someone who understands how to make the customer happy while also protecting the company's money.



You need to understand that every refund, replacement, reshipment, discount, and customer-service decision has a financial impact on the company.



You should understand:



• Refund rates

• Chargeback rates

• The financial impact of excessive refunds

• The financial impact of unnecessary replacements

• How to handle difficult customers without unnecessarily losing money

• When it makes sense to refund

• When it makes sense to replace

• When another solution is better

• How to protect the company's interests while still providing excellent customer service



The goal is not to say YES to every customer.



The goal is to find the right solution for the customer while protecting the company.





HUMAN CUSTOMER SERVICE



We do NOT want robotic customer service.



You need to understand the situation before responding.



Customers should feel that they are speaking with a real person who understands their problem.



You need to know how to:



• Listen

• Understand the real problem

• Communicate clearly

• Show empathy

• Solve problems quickly

• Keep customers satisfied

• Stay professional with difficult customers

• Protect the company at the same time



You should be able to make good decisions instead of simply following scripts.





ORGANIZATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You must be extremely organized.



You will be dealing with a large number of customer conversations, orders, refunds, returns, replacements, tracking issues, and other problems.



You need to know how to keep everything organized and make sure nothing gets forgotten.



You should naturally be someone who:



• Keeps track of open problems

• Follows up when necessary

• Documents important information

• Adds Shopify order notes when changes happen

• Keeps conversations organized

• Does not lose track of customers

• Does not need to be constantly reminded what to do

• Takes initiative when something needs to be solved





INITIATIVE IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



We want someone who sees a problem and takes action.



If you notice an order has been unfulfilled because the tracking number from the sourcing agent did not synchronize, you should already know what to investigate and what steps to take.



You should not simply wait for someone else to tell you what to do.



We want someone who thinks ahead, solves problems, and takes ownership of their work.





SPEED + ACCURACY



We work with a high volume of customer requests.



You need to work quickly without becoming careless.



We want someone who can handle a large workload while maintaining:



• Accuracy

• Organization

• Good communication

• Good judgment

• Fast response times



You should not work like a robot just trying to close tickets.



You need to understand what is happening and make the correct decision.





LEARNING FROM MISTAKES



Nobody is perfect.



Mistakes can happen.



What matters is that you learn from them.



If you make a mistake, you need to understand why it happened, correct it, and make sure you do not keep making the same mistake.



We want someone who improves over time and takes responsibility for their work.





WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who:



• Has 3–5+ years of highly relevant experience

• Has worked specifically with Shopify apparel/e-commerce brands

• Has hands-on Shopify experience

• Has Commslayer experience

• Has Gmail experience

• Understands returns and refunds

• Understands chargebacks

• Understands Shopify order management

• Understands tracking and fulfillment problems

• Understands how sourcing-agent tracking works

• Is extremely organized

• Has strong initiative

• Works fast

• Speaks and writes very good English

• Provides human customer service

• Understands customer psychology and expectations

• Understands how to protect company finances

• Takes ownership

• Learns from mistakes

• Wants to grow with the company long term

• Has genuine passion for customer service





DO NOT APPLY IF



• You have less than 3 years of relevant experience

• You have never worked directly with Shopify stores

• You have only worked in general customer service

• You have worked mainly in call centers

• You have no Shopify apparel/e-commerce experience

• You have never used Commslayer

• You do not understand Shopify returns and refunds

• You have never handled Shopify orders directly

• You have never dealt with fulfillment/tracking issues

• You are not extremely organized

• You need constant supervision

• You do not understand the financial impact of refunds and replacements

• You simply give customers whatever they ask for

• You provide robotic/scripted customer service

• You are slow

• You do not take initiative

• You repeatedly make the same mistakes

• You are looking for a short-term position



PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU HAVE REAL, HANDS-ON EXPERIENCE WITH THE SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS ABOVE.

title: Amazon Lead Finders Wanted: Full-Time Remote, Long-Term, Paid On Time | Sourcing Squad HQ

THE COMPANY

We're a 7-person team with more than 2 years behind us and plans to stick around for 20+. We source for two different Amazon seller accounts. That gives our team real stability: if one account has a bad stretch, your job doesn't disappear.



We consider ourselves one of the best sourcing teams around, and we hold a high standard. We've brought on 40 VAs and kept 6. That's not because we're difficult. It's because so many people stretch the truth about their experience. Our trial is built to find that out fast, usually within 3-4 days. If you're the real thing, you'll feel right at home with a team that matches your level.



THE PEOPLE BEHIND IT

Ian and Thomas are the owners, and they're hands-on. They're fair, they recognize strong work, and they take care of the people who deliver. They're building this company to last.



Here's the part many VAs care about most: we pay every other Monday, on time, every time. We've never once missed a payment. Never.



WHO WE WANT

Pure product sourcers who love the chase. If tracking down the next winning lead is what gets you out of bed, you're who we're looking for.



WHAT YOU NEED

- 4 or more years of hands-on Amazon product sourcing (online arbitrage), finding deals day after day

- Verifiable references from previous employers or sellers

- Working knowledge of Keepa and SellerAmp



EXPERIENCE WE DON'T COUNT

Account management, private label, wholesale, team leadership, and general "Amazon VA" work don't count here. Only time spent sourcing products counts toward the 4 years. If your resume is mostly in those areas, please don't apply.



OUR NUMBERS

Every lead needs to hit:

- 50% ROI minimum

- $7 profit per unit minimum

Those aren't stretch targets. They're the floor. If that sounds like too much, this isn't the right fit, and that's completely fine.



THE WORK

- Find profitable, approvable leads using Keepa and SellerAmp

- Catch the traps: gated and restricted brands, Amazon on the listing, price history collapses, variation mismatches, and IP-complaint brands

We track every VA on Hubstaff, with a screenshot of your screen every 2 minutes. It keeps the whole team honest and the time clock trustworthy. Honest workers have nothing to worry about. If you have bad intentions, skip this one.



PAY AND PROGRESSION

Phase 1: A 14-day paid trial at $3 USD/hour while we test your skills. Meet our expectations and get invited to the next phase, and you'll receive a $50 USD bonus at the end of the trial.

Phase 2: $3.50-$4.00/hour for 90 days while you get acclimated to the team.

Phase 3: A long-term position with a potential pay increase, paid holidays, paid time off, and more.



WHAT YOU GET

- A $50 USD bonus for finishing the trial and earning the next phase

- Reliable pay every other Monday

- Performance incentives on top of your hourly pay

- Schedule flexibility: choose at least 4 weekdays, and weekends are open too. Your days are fixed during the trial, then you can submit availability week to week.

- Only one hard requirement on hours: 40 per week

- A stable team, two seller accounts, and a company built for the long haul



WHAT MATTERS TO US

- Accuracy, honesty, and consistency, including saying so when you're unsure about a lead

- Someone looking for a long-term home rather than a short-term gig



HOW TO APPLY (skip a step and your application is deleted unread)

Open your message with the word SQUAD. Then send:

1. A GOOD resume with real thought, real detail, and accurate information. A quick resume from ChatGPT or Claude won't cut it. Show us the tools, categories, and results from your sourcing work, and keep it honest.

2. An unscripted 2-3 minute video (Loom or similar) about your 4+ years sourcing for Amazon. Cover your tools, categories, and how many leads you delivered per day in your last role. This video goes by
 to 
 not through this platform.

3. The last product you rejected, and why

4. Two past employers or sellers we can contact for references (names and contact info)

5. Availability for the 14-day trial: the 4+ weekdays you'll work (weekends welcome). After the trial, you can send availability week to week.



WHERE TO SEND THE VIDEO

 your video and anything else you couldn't include with your initial application to 
 SQUAD plus your full name as the subject line. Applications without the video are incomplete and won't be reviewed.



If you're the real deal, let's talk. If you're not sure you meet the bar, it's probably not the right fit, and that's okay.



This could be the long-term opportunity you've been looking for, to help better your life and your family's life. Our top earners are at $5-$9.50 per hour!! The growth is endless.

title: Real Estate VA: Property Onboarding, Purchasing & Reconciliation
description:
REAL ESTATE VIRTUAL ASSISTANT: PROPERTY ONBOARDING, PURCHASING AND RECONCILIATION



Please read this whole post before applying. There are instructions at the bottom, and how you follow them is the first thing we look at.



ABOUT US



We run full-service, hands-off management for short-term rental owners across the US. An owner hands us an empty house. We furnish it, wire it, stock it, style it, photograph it, license it, connect it to the booking channels and open it to guests. Then our management team runs it.



That middle part is a project with about two hundred moving pieces and a hard finish line, and right now it lives almost entirely in our founder's head. That is the whole reason this seat exists. Most days are a spreadsheet, a vendor invoice, a receipt, a permit portal and a follow-up list.



We automate everything software can do. What software cannot do is notice that a vendor invoice and a card statement disagree by $16.48 and go find out why, or notice on day one that the internet install is booked eleven days out and the permit needs a floor plan that nobody has drawn yet.



We are growing. Our written plan is 150 managed doors by the end of 2027. This is the first seat of its kind here and it will not be the last one.



WHAT THIS ROLE REALLY IS



Two lanes, one person. Every case below is real. Money amounts are changed, for a reason we explain further down. The shapes are all real.



LANE ONE, THE RECORD OF THE MONEY.



Nineteen furniture lines on a live property are flagged as ordered. There is no order number behind any of them, no charge on any card, and no confirmation from the vendor. Either they were bought and nobody wrote it down, or somebody typed a word into the wrong cell. The difference is $4,318.62. If you place that order and it was already placed, the owner pays for the same furniture twice, and nobody finds out for a month.



- Two lines carry the same item name and two different product links, so the house is getting either four sofas or two, a $2,144.75 question, and the owner is reading it as one line.

- A vendor invoice hit the card as $9,340.55 on the 12th and another $812.07 on the 19th, because that vendor captures payment as items ship. The record held only the first number, so the property looked $812.07 cheaper than it was.

- A tax column on an Oregon delivery showed $22.50 per mattress and nothing on the other sixty items. That is not tax. It is a state recycling fee that is legitimately owed, and two people here have already gotten it wrong.

- A four-figure order shipped to one property's address and belonged to a different property's plan. The ship-to address is never the answer. The item list is.

- One plan column read $10,462.31 against an order total of $10,462.08. A twenty-three cent gap between two numbers computed from completely different inputs made the row look reconciled while the real figure underneath it sat $1,384.90 low.



LANE TWO, GETTING THE HOUSE TO THE FINISH LINE.



A house is furnished, wired, cleaned and photographed, and it still cannot take a guest, because the city permit needs a floor plan, the floor plan needs a measured scan nobody has ordered, and the internet install is booked eleven days out. Somebody has to know that on day one, not in week five.



- Four separate deliveries land at a vacant house in one week. Three arrive, one is refused at the curb for freight damage, and the replacement ships to the wrong state. A box left at the door of an empty house is nobody's until somebody is named, and you are the person who names them.

- A utility account is open, but it is in the previous owner's name, autopay is off, and we are not listed as an authorized contact, which means the day the power goes out nobody at that utility will speak to us.

- A city changes its short-term rental rules mid-project. The registration the property was counting on no longer exists and the path is now a discretionary hearing. Finding that out in week two is a plan change. Finding it out in week nine is a dead launch.

- The listing goes up with the nightly rate still on the platform's starter default, the maximum stay set to 365 nights, and the house rules field empty. Every one of those is a field somebody had to set, and nobody did.

- Eight vendors are needed before the first guest: cleaner, plumber, electrician, HVAC, handyman, landscaper, pool, pest. Sourcing them is the easy half. The hard half is that every one of those phone numbers has to be dialed once before we call it a directory.



The honest description of this role: it is detective work on money, and chasing on everything else. It is quiet and it is deliberate.



The person who is great at it is the person who genuinely cannot leave a number alone when it does not tie, who would rather spend forty minutes finding the missing $16.48 than type over the cell and move on, and who also will not let a utility company, a permit office or a busy designer go three days without an answer.



This is not task-list work. Nobody is going to send you a list each morning telling you which rows to price or which office to call. You run a weekly rhythm and a countdown you can read yourself, so you already know.



If that reads as tedious to you, we would genuinely rather you skip this one. If it reads as a puzzle with a deadline, keep going.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



THE BUDGET RECORD. One Google Sheet per property, our launch budget tracker. It is the single record of what the property is buying, what it committed to, what actually got charged and what is left. Every property in flight has one and you run all of them.



- Price every row on the plan that has no price. Find the item, confirm the variant, the size and the pack quantity, and put a real number on it.

- Load the purchasing carts against the plan. This has real traps. Our cart holds a hard 50 lines, and line 51 silently pushes the oldest line out into Saved for later, so a 152 row accessories list is four separate orders and you d
 the batches up front. Re-adding an item that is already in the cart raises its quantity instead of warning you. You verify by item code and quantity, never by the badge in the corner.

- Tag every order back onto the plan rows it paid for, so nothing is bought that the sheet does not know about.

- Log every card charge as its own row, with the invoice's true order total rather than the first posting that showed up, and file the receipt the day it exists. A charge with no receipt cannot be cleanly billed back, which means a missing receipt is money the company cannot recover that month.

- Reconcile every vendor invoice against what we actually committed to, line by line, and produce the defect list. What was charged, what was ordered, what is missing, what does not agree, and which of those is a real problem versus a coi
.

- Run the flag pass every Friday. Filter the exception column and clear everything that is not clean. Some of our checks run from scripts on our side and we run them against your sheet, so your pass has to be clean before it reaches them.

- Chase our designer for the receipts, the property attributions and the open answers that nobody else is going to chase. The buying happens in person, in other states, on a company card, and store receipts print department codes instead of product names, so only the person who was standing there can say which room a $340 receipt belongs to.

- Open a tracker for a new property from our template and type the house into the quantity calculator: bedrooms, beds by size, baths, sleeps, TVs, floors. Half the quantities calculate themselves off those numbers, so this is not data entry, it is the foundation. Every count comes from a written source, and when two written sources disagree you flag it instead of picking a winner.

- Watch the envelope. The plan has a cap, and the week you first see that the plan is going to cross it, you say so out loud. Weeks early, not at the end.

- Produce the close-out: the reconciliation that says whether the owner is owed a refund or owes a true-up, and the drafted invoice or refund figure behind it.



THE COUNTDOWN. From the day the management agreement is executed to the day our management team can run the house without you.



- The calendar itself. Every property on one board, every gate current, every date real. You own the answer to "where is this house and what is it waiting on," and you own it before anybody has to ask.

- Accounts and utilities. Every account to Active in the correct name, us named as an authorized contact with call-in and outage rights, autopay and paperless set, and the internet ordered with the install date captured the day it books. That date is the longest lead time in most launches.

- Licensing, permits and tax. Research the market's short-term rental rules and confirm the property qualifies before anyone spends money assuming it does. Assemble the permit application, including the floor plan. Open the portal account, submit, and track it to ISSUED. Send the neighbor notices where they are required. Get the permit number into every advertisement. Register the lodging and occupancy tax accounts and record which channel remits what.

- Insurance and the vendor bench. Chase the certificate of insurance and file it. Source and qualify the local vendor bench, capture after-hours rates, and get recurring landscaping, pool and pest started so the first visit lands before the first guest.

- The physical fate of every order. The delivery calendar, tracking numbers, backorders, what arrived, what did not, what arrived damaged, what got reshipped and when, what got returned.

- Listing provisioning. Import the property into our management system and map every field. Confirm the two-way calendar and rate sync. Connect our pricing tool. Connect our cleaning tool, assign the cleaner and apply the right checklist. Expand to the additional channels. Stage all of it and hand it to us to publish.

- The property record. The project folder, the property file, the contact list, the service directory, warranty registrations off the serial numbers collected during install, the placement map, opening inventory counts, and the archive when it closes.

- Owner logistics, and only logistics. Signature status, a utility account number, a certificate of insurance, an app invitation that has not been accepted. Chased under our name, never yours, and never carrying a number.

- The measurement. Days from signature to first booked night, per property, recorded. Nobody here has ever written that number down. You will be the first.



HELPING BUILD THE SYSTEM. We have a written playbook for this seat and we are still finishing the SOPs behind it. You will help write them, in your own words, out of the work you actually did. As we add properties this becomes more than one seat, and the person who runs it well is the person who trains the next one.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO, AND THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT SECTION IN THIS POST



Two walls. Both are deliberate, both are permanent, and neither bends for a deadline.



THE MONEY WALL: YOU OWN THE RECORD, YOU NEVER OWN THE MOVEMENT.



Nothing you do debits a bank, releases a wire, pays a card, or reaches an owner's inbox. Not once, not in an emergency, not on a deadline.



- You never fire a charge. Every single payment, card or eCheck or wire, is approved personally by our founder, on that specific charge, every time. There is no batch approval and there is no standing permission.

- You never move money out of any bank or merchant account. You compute what should be paid and you evidence it. He releases it.

- You do not place the orders. You build the cart, you verify it line by line, you hand it over with the batch, the total, the shipping address and the property reference it needs, and somebody else presses the button.

- You are not the property owner's contact. Not the approval schedule, not an invoice, not a refund figure, not an
 with a number in it. You draft. We send. Always.

- You never add, edit or verify a vendor's bank details or payee information. Nobody in this seat does. That is the wall against invoice fraud, and urgency is the exact pretext it exists to defeat.

- You have no banking, no payment gateway and no accounting system access, on purpose. If you ever find that you somehow can reach one, you do not act, you report it.



THE BUILDING WALL: YOU RUN THE COUNTDOWN, YOU NEVER CERTIFY THE HOUSE.



You are remote. You will never stand in these houses. So there is a category of work that is structurally not yours, and we would rather you know that now than discover it in month two and feel set up to fail.



- You never certify a physical condition and you never sign a walkthrough. You schedule it, you receive its findings, you turn them into dispatched work and you track them to done. You do not perform it and you do not sign your name to it.

- You never name anyone, including yourself, as a city's required local contact. That is a legal representation about a person who can physically reach a property, and it is our founder's to make.

- You never publish a listing. You stage it completely, every field set. He calls go or no-go.

- A house being ready is not your call to make. You produce the evidence that it is. Somebody standing in it makes the call.



Read both walls as protection, not as distrust. The seat that keeps the record of the money is deliberately not the seat that moves it, because a record that can move money is not a record, it is an opinion. The seat that runs the countdown is deliberately not the seat that certifies the building, because a countdown that can declare itself finished is not a countdown. Those separations are what make your close-out number and your green light worth something, and they mean that when money or a guest goes somewhere it should not have, it is structurally impossible for it to have been you. We designed it that way on purpose, we will not ask you to bend it, and we think it is one of the best parts of the offer.



A WORD ABOUT CONFIDENTIALITY



You will see what we pay for goods and what the owner is billed for them. That information does not leave the company, ever, for any reason, including to an owner who asks you directly and including when they are being nice about it. If that is not a line you can hold comfortably, please do not apply. It is written into the agreement and we take it seriously.



The same applies in the other direction. You never structure anything: no splitting an order, sequencing a purchase, or shaping a number so it sits under a threshold. And no order, vendor or reimbursement that benefits you or anyone connected to you. Either one is immediate cause, even if the underlying purchase was perfectly fine.



MUST-HAVES



We are not going to write "detail oriented" here, because everybody says it about themselves and it predicts nothing. Here is what actually predicts success in this seat.



- 2+ years in a role where reconciling one document against another was the actual job. Accounts payable, bookkeeping, procurement, e-commerce operations, inventory control, order desk, audit support. Something where a number had to tie and you were the one who made it tie.

- You know that a total matching is not proof it is right. Two numbers built from completely different inputs can land within a dollar of each other by coi
, look tied, and hide a four-figure error underneath. Somebody who checks totals and stops will not survive here.

- You understand that one number can arrive as several charges. A single vendor order can hit a card as three postings weeks apart. Log the first one and the record is quietly wrong forever, and nothing on the sheet will tell you.

- You chase small discrepancies to the bottom. If a total is off by $16.48, we need the person who finds the $16.48, not the person who adjusts the total.

- You can hold an open discrepancy without doing either wrong thing with it. The two failure modes are dropping it because it is small and inventing a reason for it because you want it closed. Both are worse than a note that says "unexplained, $16.48, chasing." If you have ever kept a variance open for two weeks because you refused to guess, tell us about it.

- You have run something with a deadline and many moving parts, and you can show us the instrument you ran it on. A launch, an onboarding, a move, an event, an implementation, a store opening. Not "I am organized." The actual tracker, board or sheet, and what you did the week it started slipping.

- You follow up politely and repeatedly with somebody who is busy, who is not your subordinate, and who has no reason to prioritize you. Utility companies, city permit offices, vendors, a designer in another state. This does not resolve itself and it is a large part of the job's value.

- You leave alone what you do not understand. Some of our sheets carry hand-marked rows whose meaning was never written down. Our standing rule is preserve, never interpret. A near-pattern is a trap, not a shortcut, and finishing one makes six edits nobody can undo.

- Real spreadsheet fluency, not "proficient in Excel" on a resume. SUMIFS, lookups, filters, spotting a hardcoded number sitting where a formula should be, and knowing what happens to a sheet when someone inserts a column into the middle of it. We will test this and it is not a hard test if this is true of you. You do not need to code.

- You can tell someone senior to you that a number is wrong, or that a date is not going to hold. Comfortably, in writing, with the evidence attached. Bad news early is the single most valuable thing you will ever send us.

- Stamina for a long pass. Some days are 150 rows of the same check. We need the 150th to get the same attention as the first.

- Honest. If you have not confirmed something, you say so. You never report a status you did not verify and you never invent a number, a price, a quantity, a receipt, a confirmation or which property a charge belongs to. "I do not know yet, here is how I am finding out" is always the right answer. This is the single most important item on this list and it is a hard gate at every stage of our process.

- Clear, professional written English. You will write to US vendors, US city offices and a US designer about money and deadlines.

- Stable power and internet, plus a backup for outages.

- Able to work the fixed shift below. Please read the hours section carefully before you apply.



NICE-TO-HAVES



- Property management, real estate operations, or short-term rental background.

- You have dealt with a government or municipal office and got a thing issued. Permits, licensing, registrations, business filings, customs, anything where a form met a bureaucracy and you won.

- Trade, wholesale or B2B purchasing account experience.

- You have reconciled a credit card statement against a set of vendor invoices and found something.

- You have chased a vendor for a credit and won.

- Bookkeeping exposure, QuickBooks or Xero or similar, even read-only.

- Furniture, interior design, hospitality FF&E, or construction procurement background.

- Experience with a property management system, a dynamic pricing tool, or a cleaning scheduling tool.

- You have built a tracker or a process that somebody else then used without you in the room.

- A little Google Apps Script or Python, or genuine curiosity about the scripts behind our sheets. Not required. Rewarded.



HOURS AND TIMEZONE



This is a fixed US business-hours shift. Please read the conversion below carefully.



- The shift is 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM US Pacific, Monday through Friday. Eight hours a day, forty hours a week. You are online and responsive for the whole of it.

- In the Philippines that is 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM, starting the following day. It is an overnight shift. Pacific is fifteen hours behind Manila in US daylight time, so an 8:00 AM Pacific start is 11:00 PM in Manila and a 4:00 PM Pacific finish is 7:00 AM in Manila. We are stating that plainly so nobody works out the math after they have accepted.

- The shift moves by one hour in Manila terms when the US changes to and from daylight saving time. The Pacific hours stay 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

- Why this window and not a later one. Half this job is other people's business hours. Utility companies, city permit offices, vendor support and freight carriers on the US East Coast close at 2:00 PM Pacific. This shift gives you six hours of overlap with them. A later shift would give you three, and you would spend your life waiting a day for every answer.

- Some deadlines in this job are actual dates. The Friday flag pass happens on Friday. Ordering deadlines and permit windows are the other kind, and they do not move.

- No weekends. No overnight emergencies outside your shift. Those stay with us.



Be honest with yourself about the overnight window before you apply. If 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM does not fit your life, please do not apply, and there is no hard feeling in that.



If you are somewhere other than the Philippines, do the conversion yourself and tell us on the form what 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific is where you are. We do read that answer.



COMPENSATION



- $1,000 per month, for the arrangement above.

- The rate is flat. It does not step up as the scope grows. We would rather say that plainly than describe an increase we have not committed to, so you can plan on this number.

- Merit review at 90 days after conversion, then annually. That is where the rate gets revisited.

- We honor 13th month pay. We offer flexible coordinated time off and we cover your equipment. We treat our people well and the good ones grow with us.

- Paid trial first. Before any ongoing offer there is a short paid project, a couple of hours of real work, and we pay you for it.

- The first four weeks are an Initial Evaluation Term at close to full rate, so both sides get a real look before anyone commits.



HOW WE HIRE



We use a multi-step process and it is deliberately demanding. Every stage is something you do on your own time, and we do not schedule a single call until you have already shown us how you work. In order: a short application form, a 2-minute video, a written reconciliation exercise, a personality assessment, then an interview and a paid trial. Budget roughly two to three hours of your own time across all of it before the paid trial, which we pay for. The personality assessment is a tiebreaker, not a gate, and nobody is rejected on it alone.



The reconciliation exercise is the stage that d
 this seat. It is a real invoice against a real plan with the names taken out, it does not tie, and the reason it does not tie is not the reason you will first think it is. There is no trick, but there is a wrong answer that most people give, and it is the confident one.



We move fast, and you set the pace. There is no application window and no waiting for a batch. Each stage unlocks the moment you finish the one before it, and every deadline is measured from when the
 reaches you, not from a date on our calendar. Somebody who moves promptly can go from applying to a paid trial in a couple of weeks.



Deadlines are real at every stage. If you miss one, you are out. Please do not ask for an extension.



HOW TO APPLY



Fill out the form linked at the very bottom of this post.



Applications sent any other way will not be reviewed. Please do not message us on this platform, do not
 us, and do not send a resume in a reply. Only form submissions are looked at. We know that is strict. It is the first filter and it is working as intended.



Read the form carefully. One of the questions is there to check that you read this post.



Apply here:

title: Estimator
description:
Part-Time Assistant Estimator

Whisperts Acoustics, Inc.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Part-Time Assistant Estimator to support our Head Estimator in preparing accurate and competitive bids for commercial acoustic treatment projects.

The ideal candidate will have experience in construction estimating, preferably within commercial interiors, architectural finishes, or specialty subcontracting.

Key Responsibilities:

Assist the Head Estimator with reviewing architectural drawings, specifications, and project documents.

Perform accurate material quantity takeoffs using Bluebeam and other estimating tools.

Prepare cost estimates for acoustic wall panels, acoustic ceilings, fabric-wrapped panels, PET panels, and related specialty systems.

Assist in preparing bid proposals, pricing breakdowns, and scope of work documents.

Review addenda, revisions, and updated drawings to identify changes affecting project pricing.

Contact manufacturers and suppliers to obtain material pricing, lead times, and technical information.

Identify scope gaps, discrepancies, and potential issues in project documents.

Support bid submissions, value engineering, and estimate revisions.

Maintain organized estimating files, bid trackers, and project documentation.

Coordinate directly with the Head Estimator to ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely submission of bids.

Qualifications:

Previous experience in commercial construction estimating.

Proficiency in Bluebeam, Microsoft Excel, and reading architectural drawings.

Familiarity with commercial interior finishes and acoustic treatment systems is a plus.

Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to meet deadlines.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Ability to work independently while following the Head Estimator's guidance.

This is a part-time support position. The Assistant Estimator will work directly under our Head Estimator, helping manage estimating workloads, improve bid turnaround times, and support the continued growth of Whisperts Acoustics.

title: Founder Content Writer / Ghostwriter
description:
Founder Content Writer / Ghostwriter - LinkedIn, X and Newsletter



We are looking for one dedicated writer to become the long-term writing partner to a UK-based founder/operator in e-commerce and social commerce.



This is not a generic social media manager role and it is not high-volume SEO writing. The job is to learn one founder's voice, extract strong ideas from conversations and source material, and turn them into sharp, useful content across LinkedIn, X and a weekly newsletter.



The current content operation already has an audience, source material and a working publishing rhythm. We now want one person who can build context over time, improve the quality and own the writing consistently. You will work directly with the founder and internal team. The role will not be passed between writers.



What you will own:

- A weekly 30-45 minute content interview with the founder

- 4-5 LinkedIn posts per week across different formats

- 1-3 longer article-style X posts or threads per week

- One newsletter per week

- Research, fact-checking and turning company/client insights into useful content without exposing confidential details

- A simple editorial calendar, revisions and a record of what performs

- Repurposing ideas across channels without copying the same post word-for-word



You may be a fit if:

- You have written in a founder, executive or subject-matter expert's voice before

- Your English is excellent and your writing sounds natural, specific and human

- You can interview someone, spot the strongest angle and challenge weak ideas

- You understand the differences between LinkedIn, X and

- You are comfortable writing about e-commerce, marketing, agencies, creator commerce or adjacent business topics

- You are reliable, responsive and want a long-term role with one team



This is not a fit if your experience is mainly generic blogs, AI-generated content, captions or scheduling. Tools can support research and editing, but the thinking, interviewing and final writing must be yours. You must personally write the work; no subcontracting.



To apply, send:

title: Senior Social Media Content Strategist & Video Editor
description:
# Senior Social Media Content Strategist & Video Editor



**Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Position**

**Compensation: $1,000–$1,500 USD/month + Performance Bonuses**



## THIS IS NOT A BASIC SOCIAL MEDIA VA POSITION.



PB Agency is looking for an exceptional **Social Media Content Strategist & Video Editor** who understands what makes people STOP scrolling, WATCH content, SHARE it, and eventually BUY.



We are a fast-growing U.S.-based marketing agency working with entrepreneurs, educators, experts, and personal brands.



We do not need someone who simply waits for us to tell them what to post.



We need someone who can look at a brand and say:



**“Here are 10 content ideas we should create this week—and here's why I believe they'll work.”**



If you constantly study Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, creators, trends, hooks, editing styles, storytelling, and viral content, we want to hear from you.



## YOUR ROLE



You will help PB Agency and our clients develop and execute high-performing organic social media content.



You will be responsible for the entire content process:



**IDEA → STRATEGY → EDIT → POST → ANALYZE → IMPROVE**



### Your Responsibilities



* Develop new content ideas every week

* Research emerging social media trends

* Study competitors and successful creators

* Identify viral content formats we can adapt for our brands

* Create strong hooks and opening sequences

* Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and

* Repurpose long-form videos, podcasts, Zoom calls and trainings into short-form content

* Edit long-form YouTube content when necessary

* Add captions, B-roll, graphics, zooms, pattern interrupts and other retention elements

* Create social graphics and carousels

* Write captions and post copy

* Schedule and publish content

* Maintain content calendars

* Organize raw and completed content

* Monitor content performance

* Review views, retention, engagement, shares, saves and other performance metrics

* Identify what's working and recommend what we should create next



Most importantly:



**You are expected to BRING IDEAS to the company—not just execute ours.**



## WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should have at least **2–3 years of professional social media/content experience**.



You should understand:



* Instagram Reels

* TikTok

* YouTube Shorts

* YouTube long-form

*

* Personal-brand content

* Educational content

* Direct-response content

* Storytelling

* Hooks

* Viewer retention

* Pattern interrupts

* Content repurposing

* Social media algorithms

* Trend identification



You should be highly proficient with tools such as:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* CapCut

* Final Cut Pro

* After Effects

* Canva

* Photoshop

* AI content tools



You don't need to know every program listed above.



**We care about your OUTPUT more than the software you use.**



## YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF...



You watch a Reel and immediately think about why the first 3 seconds worked.



You notice editing styles before most people notice they're becoming trends.



You can take a 45-minute podcast and identify the 10 moments most likely to perform as short-form content.



You can study successful creators and reverse-engineer why their content works.



You understand that great editing isn't about adding random effects—it's about maintaining attention.



You are comfortable receiving feedback and making changes quickly.



You don't need someone constantly telling you what to do.



And you're obsessed with becoming exceptional at social media.



## THIS POSITION IS NOT FOR YOU IF...



You only know how to schedule posts.



You need someone to provide every content idea.



You consider yourself primarily a virtual assistant.



You have never professionally edited videos.



You don't actively consume and study social media.



You cannot explain why one piece of content performed better than another.



You are managing 10 freelance clients and looking for another one.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a **long-term member of PB Agency.**



## COMPENSATION



**Starting Compensation: $1,000–$1,500 USD/month**



Final compensation depends on experience, portfolio, editing ability, strategic thinking and demonstrated results.



There will also be opportunities for:



* Performance bonuses

* Compensation increases

* Increased responsibility

* Leadership opportunities



An exceptional person could eventually grow into a **Head of Content / Creative Director** position within PB Agency.



## HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT send us a generic application.



At the very top of your application write:



**“I WANT TO BUILD PB.”**



Then send us:



1. Your resume

2. Your portfolio

3. Your 5 BEST short-form videos

4. Your 2 BEST long-form videos, if available

5. Links to social media accounts you've helped manage or grow

6. Any screenshots showing results you've generated

7. Your current/most recent monthly compensation

8. Your expected monthly compensation



Then answer these questions:



**QUESTION #1**



Send us 3 creators or brands that you believe are producing some of the best social media content right now.



Explain WHY you chose each one.



**QUESTION #2**



If we gave you a 60-minute podcast episode, explain how you would turn it into 15+ pieces of social media content.



**QUESTION #3**



What do you believe separates a video that gets 5,000 views from one that gets 500,000+ views?



**QUESTION #4**



What social media trend or content format do you believe businesses are currently underutilizing?



Explain why.



## FINAL STEP



Candidates who make it through the initial application will receive a **PAID content test.**



We will provide raw footage.



You will be asked to:



* Identify the strongest content angle

* Write 3 potential hooks

* Edit one short-form video

* Create a caption

* Explain how you would distribute the content

* Provide 3 additional content ideas based on the footage





**We are looking for someone exceptional who wants to grow with PB Agency long-term.**

title: VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — QC & DELIVERY SPECIALIST
description:
VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — QC & DELIVERY SPECIALIST

Company: Fulshear Property Visuals 

Position: Remote Virtual Assistant — QC & Delivery

 Starting Pay: $5/hour 

Starting Hours: 20-25 hours per week, with opportunities for additional hours in the future 

Schedule: Tuesday–Saturday 

Location: Remote



ABOUT FULSHEAR PROPERTY VISUALS

Fulshear Property Visuals is a professional real estate media company based in Fulshear, Texas. We provide professional photography, drone photography and video, virtual tours, video, and other visual media services to real estate agents, property managers, builders, businesses, and other clients.



We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant who wants to grow with our company.

The starting position will focus primarily on Quality Control (QC) and Delivery, but this position is intended to grow into a larger role as you become familiar with our systems, standards, and workflow.



Our goal is to develop someone who can eventually take on a lead role within the VA side of our company.



STARTING POSITION: QC & DELIVERY

Your primary responsibility will be to make sure completed photo and video projects meet our quality standards before they are delivered to clients.



You will:

* Download completed projects from our editing platforms.

* Review completed photos and videos for quality and consistency.

* Perform quality control before projects are delivered.

* Make corrections when necessary.

* Upload and organize completed projects in our client delivery system.

* Verify that all services ordered by the client have been completed and delivered.

* Add drone pinpoints above homes in aerial images when required.

* Add lot lines or other required markings when necessary.

* Communicate with editors regarding corrections and revisions.

* Communicate through SMS,
, Slack, Instagram, and other platforms as needed.

* Respond promptly and professionally to messages.

* Make sure projects are delivered accurately and on time.



PHOTO QUALITY CONTROL

We use Auto HDR, an AI-powered photo editing system, as part of our editing workflow.

However, AI does not replace the need for an experienced photo editor.

You will be responsible for carefully reviewing the completed Auto HDR images and identifying anything the AI may have missed or incorrectly edited.



This includes checking for:

* Incorrect or inconsistent color

* Exposure problems

* White balance issues

* Unnatural HDR results

* Editing inconsistencies

* Items that should have been removed

* Grass or landscaping issues

* TV screen replacements

* Bracketed photo editing issues

* Other visual problems that do not meet our standards



You may also need to compare the edited image against the original RAW files to determine whether the final image accurately represents the property.



It is extremely important that you have a strong eye for detail and consistency.



Our goal is not simply to deliver images that have been processed by AI. Our goal is to deliver images that meet the Fulshear Property Visuals standard.



ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

As you become comfortable with QC and delivery, additional responsibilities may be assigned, including:



Client Communication:

* Responding to client
s and text messages.

* Assisting with client communication and follow-up.

* Helping with client acquisition activities.



Instagram Method:

During available time, you may assist with our social media outreach strategy by:

* Liking posts.

* Commenting on posts.

* Engaging with real estate agents.

* Following potential clients.

* Performing other Instagram outreach activities.



Virtual Assistant Tasks:

Additional administrative, organizational, research, communication, or operational tasks may be assigned as needed.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

You should have:

* Strong written and spoken English.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong organizational skills.

* Experience with Adobe Photoshop.

* Experience with Adobe Lightroom.

* Experience reviewing and editing photographs.

* The ability to identify subtle color and editing problems.

* The ability to follow detailed instructions and company standards.

* Reliable communication and responsiveness.

* A fast and stable internet connection.

* A reliable computer capable of handling photo editing.

* The ability to work independently.



Previous QC, photo editing, real estate photography, or project delivery experience is strongly preferred.



EQUIPMENT & INTERNET REQUIREMENTS:

You must have:

* A reliable computer suitable for photo editing.

* Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom or equivalent professional editing experience.

* Fast and stable internet.

* A backup plan in case of internet or power failure.



We want to know that you can continue communicating with the team and completing your responsibilities if something goes wrong with your primary internet or power.



TEST PROJECT:

If you are selected to move forward in the hiring process, we will provide you with a test project.



The test may include tasks such as:

* Editing bracketed real estate photos.

* Grass screening/replacement.

* Object or item removal.

* Color correction and touch-ups.

* TV screen replacements.

* Drone pinpoints on listing addresses.

* Photo quality control.

* Comparing edited images against RAW files.

* Other tasks related to our real estate media workflow.



The purpose of the test is to determine whether your technical skills, attention to detail, and editing judgment meet our standards.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY

This is intended to be a long-term position for the right person.

You will start primarily with QC and Delivery.

As you gain experience with our systems and demonstrate reliability and accuracy, you can take on additional responsibilities.



More responsibility can lead to:

* More hours.

* Additional duties.

* Increased responsibility within the company.

* Future raises.

* Opportunities to become a lead VA.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with Fulshear Property Visuals, rather than someone who is simply looking for a short-term job.



Our goal is to build systems, train people properly, and develop team members who can eventually take ownership of important parts of our operation.



HOW TO APPLY

DO NOT APPLY THROUGH ONLINEJOBS.PH.

Instead, send your application directly to:



IMPORTANT —
 SUBJECT LINE. Your
 subject line MUST contain: Flushear Property Visuals Rocks



Applications that do not follow the subject-line requirement may not be considered.



REQUIRED APPLICATION QUESTIONS

Please answer all three questions in your
:

Do you have any previous job experience in QC and delivery, and are you currently working anywhere else?

BONUS — VIDEO APPLICATION

Bonus points if you answer the three questions above in a short video.

You may attach the video to your application or provide a link to the video.

This is completely optional, but it gives us an opportunity to see how you communicate and explain your experience.



PORTFOLIO

BEFORE APPLYING

Please carefully read this entire job posting before applying.

We are looking for someone who:



Pays attention to details.

Communicates clearly.

Follows instructions.

Takes responsibility for their work.

Can work independently.

Wants to learn.

And wants to grow with the company.



If that sounds like you, send your application to:

Please answer all three required questions, provide your equipment and internet screenshots, and include your portfolio and/or video application if available.

title: Instagram DM Marketing Expert For Collabs (Lead Gen & Outreach)
description:
Job Title: Instagram Cold DM Marketing Expert for Creator Collaborations (Hourly + $50/Collab Bonus)



About the Role



We're looking for an experienced Instagram DM marketer who knows how to start conversations that convert without torching the account in the process. Your goal is simple: reach out to content creators, build genuine conversations, and land content collaborations for our brand. You'll own our Instagram outreach channel end to end, covering strategy, execution, tracking, and reporting. That includes creating, warming up, and bringing to life the new Instagram accounts that will be used for the cold DMs. This is a hands-on role, and you run it yourself.



What You'll Do



• Create the new Instagram accounts that will be used for cold DM outreach, including profile setup, branding, and positioning so they look like real, active accounts from day one

• Warm up each account properly before any outreach begins: aging, gradual activity increases, and normal engagement patterns

• Post content and bring the accounts to life: feed posts, stories, and reels, plus genuine day-to-day engagement so they stay healthy, active, and credible

• Plan and execute Instagram cold DM outreach campaigns to content creators that generate qualified conversations and booked collaborations

• Build and maintain a prospect list of 20,000 to 30,000 target creator accounts based on criteria we provide (niche, follower range, engagement quality)

• Manage day-to-day engagement: outbound DMs, replies, follow-ups, and story-based nurture. You're the first point of contact creators see, so you represent the brand

• Track reply rates, conversation rates, and collaborations closed, then iterate weekly

• Write and A/B test DM scripts and collab pitches that feel human and personal, not copy-paste spam

• Report results directly to the owner



Requirements (Must-Haves)



• Proven experience managing Instagram cold DM outreach campaigns, with results you can show

• Hands-on experience creating and warming up Instagram accounts for outreach, and keeping them alive with regular posting and engagement so they stay in good standing

• Experience pitching collaborations, partnerships, or ambassador deals to creators is a big plus

• Deep understanding of Instagram's rate limits, automation policies, and what actually keeps accounts in good standing (we want sustainable growth, not account churn)

• Ability to run campaigns independently, start to finish, including account creation, warm-up, and content posting

• Strong written English and conversational instincts, since creator outreach lives or dies on tone

• Familiarity with outreach/CRM tracking (spreadsheet or tool of your choice)

• Be willing to work in controversial niches**



Compensation



• $4.60 USD/hour

• $50 USD bonus per successfully executed collaboration with a content creator (target: 6 completed collabs/month once scaled)

• Part Time (May evolve into full time if we can scale to 50 Instagram accounts to dm people) If we're getting results, we'll ramp it up more and you can take on more responsibility like scheduling and logistics. If you want more work I can always find more for you to do.



How to Apply



Reply to this job post with "IG cold DM genius" in the subject line. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



In your reply, include an answer to only 1 of the following:



• Your experience with Instagram cold DM campaigns: niches, volume, and results (reply rates, leads generated, collaborations or sales closed)

• Your experience creating and warming up Instagram accounts, and how you keep them active and healthy long term

• Any experience specifically pitching creators for collabs, sponsorships, or partnerships

• The tools you've used (automation, scheduling, tracking, CRM)

• How you structure outreach so accounts stay healthy and compliant long-term

• A short example DM opener you'd use to pitch a content collaboration in our niche



You'll be evaluated on your demonstrated ability to manage Instagram DM campaigns and your past results, not generic marketing claims.

title: Video Uploader & Publishing Specialist  – Remote, PH
description:
Love hitting "publish" and watching the numbers start moving? We need you on our team, every single day.



We're a growing YouTube media company running a portfolio of channels, and we publish videos at real volume — multiple uploads a day, across several channels, every day of the week. We're looking for a dedicated YouTube Uploader to own that pipeline: taking finished videos from our editors and getting them live, correctly, on time, every time.

This is not a "set it and forget it" task. You'll be the last checkpoint before a video goes public — the person who catches a wrong thumbnail, a missing tag, or a scheduling mistake before it becomes a problem. If you're the kind of person who double-checks a form before hitting submit, you'll fit right in.



The essentials up front, no guessing:

• 🌏 100% remote / work from home anywhere in the Philippines.

• 🕐 Full-time. Because we publish daily across several channels, this role needs real, consistent daily availability not a squeeze-it-in-when-I-can arrangement. Flexible on when in the day you work, firm on showing up every day.

• 🌐 Fast, stable internet is non-negotiable. You'll be uploading and downloading large video files daily; a slow or unreliable connection bottlenecks the whole pipeline. Please don't apply without it.



What You'll Do

Publishing

• Receive finished videos from editors and upload them to the correct channel, accurately and on schedule

• Write and optimize titles, descriptions, and tags for each video for searchability

• Upload the correct thumbnail per house style for each channel

• Set the right visibility (public/scheduled/premiere), category, language, and captions before publish

• Add end screens and cards, and slot each video into the right playlist(s)

• Do a final quality check correct resolution, aspect ratio, audio, no glitches before anything goes live



Channel & workflow management

• Keep multiple channels organized and consistent, each with its own naming and metadata conventions

• Track every upload in a shared log status, publish time, any issues flagged

• Flag copyright/Content ID claims or community guideline issues immediately

• Coordinate with editors and channel managers so nothing publishes out of order or ahead of schedule

• Handle real volume multiple videos a day, across multiple channels without dropping quality or missing a slot



What You Need

• Fast, reliable internet you can count on daily the single most important requirement for this role

• Full-time availability, every day we publish this is a high-volume role and needs someone with the time to give it consistently

• Comfortable navigating YouTube Studio, or quick to learn it we'll train you

• Meticulous with detail a wrong tag or a mistimed publish is exactly what this role exists to prevent

• Comfortable handling large video files and cloud storage (Google Drive, Dropbox, or similar)

• Decent written English for titles and descriptions

• A reliable computer and a backup plan for power or internet interruptions



Nice to have, not required

• Experience uploading to or managing more than one YouTube channel

• Experience with Multilogin or similar multi-account browser tools





How to Apply:

We're hiring quickly for this one, so please fill out the application form: 





No interview for this role. 



Applicants who complete the steps above and look like a fit go straight to a short paid trial upload task a real, small batch of videos, so you can show us how you work instead of talking about it. Pass the trial, and you're in.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and hire on skill, reliability, and attention to detail alone.



Ready? Apply now! We're filling this role fast.

title: B2B Outbound Lead Prospecting & Sales Specialist (Setter to Closer Path)
description:
Role: B2B Outbound Lead Prospecting & Sales Specialist (Setter to Closer Path)

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday – Friday, Pacific Standard Time (Flexible: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM PST Part-Time or 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST Full-Time)

Start Date: Immediate





Compensation & Career Progression:

We believe in supporting you while you build your pipeline, offering guaranteed baseline pay during onboarding and a transparent pathway to step into a high-earning, full-cycle closing role as you gain experience.



• Stage 1 — Onboarding Setter Track:

o Competitive Guaranteed Base Pay ($3.00 – $3.50+ USD / hour, negotiable based on outbound B2B experience)

o +$30 – $50 bonus for every qualified appointment that turns into a closed deal

o Guaranteed income while you learn our niche, build lead lists, and master the outreach script.

• Stage 2 — Performance Commission (Setting Track):

o Optional Commission-Only Track

o 10% – 12% of project value ($50 – $200+ per deal, based on website scopes starting at $500+) when you source the lead, book the discovery call, and we close the sale.



• Stage 3 — Full-Cycle Closer Track (Promotion Opportunity):

o Optional Commission-Only Track

o Up to 20% – 25% of total project revenue ($100 – $500+ per closed client).

o Unlocked once you master our offer and take over running website audits, sales presentations, and closing client agreements directly.

o Target monthly earnings: $1,200 – $2,500+ USD (uncapped).

• Payouts: Paid on time, bi-weekly via Wise or Revolut.





Job Overview



We build modern, high-converting websites for small and medium-sized local businesses across the United States. We are looking for an ambitious, ethical, and resourceful B2B Sales Specialist.

You will start by identifying local businesses with strong community reputations (4.0+ stars on Google Maps and Yelp) that currently lack an active or modern website, reaching out to owners, and booking them for complimentary digital audits. As you become proficient with our solutions and objections, you will have the opportunity to run the sales calls yourself and close deals end-to-end.



Key Responsibilities



• Reputation-First Prospecting: Search Google Maps and Yelp for established local businesses (contractors, trades, auto services, specialty clinics, local dining) with strong ratings that have no website, broken links, or outdated pages.

• Need Qualification: Verify that the business is active, healthy, and would genuinely profit from an inbound web presence.

• Decision-Maker Discovery: Track down the actual owner or principal decision-maker using public records, social platforms, and brief verification calls.

• Multi-Touch Outreach: Execute cold calls, personalized follow-up emails, and direct messaging using our conversational, non-pushy outreach frameworks.

• Pipeline Management: Schedule qualified business owners onto the discovery calendar, maintain organized CRM records, and prepare to transition into running product walkthroughs and closing deals.

Candidate Requirements

• B2B Cold Outreach Experience: 1+ years of outbound calling, cold outreach, or appointment setting targeting US or North American business owners.

• Conversational English Fluency: Professional, natural verbal communication with clear tonality on US phone lines.

• Consultative Ethics: We sell real solutions to businesses with clear digital gaps—no high-pressure or misleading tactics.

• Growth Ambition: Eager to develop beyond basic appointment setting into a full-cycle sales professional who presents offers and closes contracts.

• Schedule Alignment: Reliable availability during core US Pacific business hours.

Technical Setup Requirements

• Hardware: Dedicated laptop or PC (minimum Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3, 8 GB RAM).

• Connectivity: Stable high-speed internet (minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload) plus a mandatory mobile data / hotspot backup.

• Audio/Video: Dedicated noise-canceling USB headset and a functional webcam for internal team check-ins.

• Environment: Quiet, distraction-free home office setup.



How to Apply



To confirm your attention to detail, include this format in your application exactly as:

[Your Full Name] - Web Sales Specialist - 0904





Submit your application with the following:



1. Your updated resume highlighting your outbound sales and appointment-setting experience.

2. A short (60–90 second) Loom video or audio recording covering:

o How you determine whether a business with no website is actually a good sales prospect.

o How you navigate past gatekeepers to speak directly with the owner.

3. A screenshot of your current internet speed test.
