title: Dispute manager for a fashion dropshipping store USA
description:
Hey there!



We’re looking for an experienced Senior Chargeback & Dispute Specialist to join our growing USA-focused fashion e-commerce brand.



Our team is based in The Netherlands, while we sell exclusively to customers in the United States. We need someone who can independently manage payment disputes, build strong evidence cases, and help reduce future chargebacks.



This is not an entry-level role. We’re looking for someone with real e-commerce dispute experience who can make an immediate impact.



---



🧠 What We’re Looking For



* At least 1 year of experience handling chargebacks and payment disputes for an e-commerce or fashion dropshipping store.

* Experience working for a store generating at least $100,000 USD per month.

* Proven experience with WHOP Disputes and Shopify Chargebacks.

* Strong experience collecting, organizing, and presenting evidence for disputes.

* A good understanding of chargeback reason codes and dispute procedures.

* Excellent written English.

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

* High attention to detail and the ability to work independently.

* Experience with PayPal and Klarna Merchant Portal is a strong advantage.



---



🚀 Your Responsibilities



You will manage the complete chargeback process from start to finish.



Your responsibilities include:



* Reviewing and managing incoming chargebacks and payment disputes.

* Contacting customers where possible to resolve issues before a dispute is finalized.

* Preparing professional dispute responses with strong supporting evidence.

* Submitting disputes through WHOP, Shopify, PayPal, Klarna, and other payment platforms when needed.

* Collecting and organizing order details, tracking information, customer communication, supplier information, and store policies.

* Maintaining accurate dispute documentation, spreadsheets, and internal reports.

* Monitoring dispute trends and identifying recurring issues.

* Working closely with customer support, suppliers, and management to reduce future chargebacks.

* Recommending practical improvements that lower dispute rates and improve the customer experience.



We’re looking for someone who focuses not only on winning disputes, but also on preventing them.



---



📈 What We Expect



* Clear, professional communication and documentation.

* Strong evidence packages that maximize the chance of winning disputes.

* Accurate and organized reporting.

* Ownership and initiative from day one.

* A proactive approach to identifying and reducing recurring chargeback issues.



---



🌱 Growth Opportunity



We are hiring early because we are preparing for further growth.



The position will start with limited hours, allowing you to become familiar with our business and processes. As the company grows and your contribution becomes more valuable, your working hours and hourly rate can grow with us.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term working relationship.



---



📋 How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. What type of e-commerce or fashion dropshipping stores you have worked for.

2. Which countries those stores sold to.

3. The approximate monthly revenue of those stores.

4. How long you worked there and your main responsibilities.

5. Which payment platforms you have experience with, such as WHOP, Shopify Payments, PayPal, Klarna, Stripe, or Airwallex.

6. Your approximate dispute win rate, if available.

7. Why should we choose you? Tell us what experience, value, or ideas you would bring to our business.



Please keep your application clear and honest. We want to understand whether your experience matches what we need.



---



🎥 What to Expect After You Apply



If your experience looks like a potential fit, we will send you a short video introduction.



In this video, you’ll get to know us, our business, how we work, and what we expect from the person joining our team. It gives both sides the opportunity to see whether this role feels like the right fit.



After watching the video, you can share your thoughts with us. If we both feel there is a good match, we will schedule a call to discuss the next steps.



---



⚠️ Important



Only apply if:



* You have read this entire post carefully.

* You meet the experience requirements above.

* You have genuine experience handling e-commerce payment disputes.

* You are ready to work independently and take ownership.

* You are serious about a long-term role.



If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you.

title: Career, Outreach & Business Operations Assistant
description:
# Virtual Executive Assistant — Career, Outreach & Business Operations



## Position Overview



I am looking for a highly organized, resourceful, AI-savvy Virtual Executive Assistant to help manage my job search, professional networking, follow-ups, calendar, personal priorities, and business-related scheduling.



This is not a basic administrative VA position.



I need someone who can take ownership of ongoing tasks, conduct independent research, use AI effectively, pay close attention to details, identify problems before I notice them, and help make sure my professional and personal commitments stay organized.



A major part of this position will involve managing my job-search process from beginning to end.



## Primary Responsibilities



### 1. Job Research



Find relevant employment opportunities for me every business day using:



- My resume and professional background

- ChatGPT/AI

- 

- LinkedIn

- Indeed

- Company career pages

- Other reputable job platforms



Primary target roles include:



- Sales Development Representative — SDR

- Business Development Representative — BDR

- Account Executive — AE

- Sales Representative

- Business Development

- Partnerships

- Creator/Influencer Partnerships

- E-commerce sales

- Social commerce/TikTok Shop-related sales



Priority industries include:



- Music

- Music technology

- Influencer marketing

- Creator economy

- TikTok/social commerce

- E-commerce

- Artificial intelligence

- SaaS

- Healthcare

- Medical technology

- Food delivery

- Logistics/delivery technology

- B2B services

- B2C services



### Job Qualification Criteria



Prioritize positions that are:



- Entry-level

- No experience required

- Training provided

- Sales trainee programs

- New graduate/early career friendly

- 0–2 years of required sales experience

- Open to transferable experience

- Remote, hybrid, or geographically relevant to me



Do NOT blindly apply to jobs simply to meet an application quota.



Every opportunity should first be checked against my qualifications and career goals.



Target: approximately **10 qualified applications per business day / 50 per week** when enough suitable opportunities are available.



---



## 2. Resume Tailoring



Before submitting applications:



1. Read the complete job description.

2. Compare the position against my master resume.

3. Identify discrepancies, missing information, weak wording, or potential conflicts.

4. Identify the most important skills, responsibilities, keywords, and qualifications from the job posting.

5. Use my established AI resume formula/process to determine appropriate changes.

6. Manually edit the resume using my existing Google Docs resume template.

7. Preserve the formatting and structure of the template.

8. Verify every statement for accuracy.

9. Never invent experience, accomplishments, companies, credentials, dates, or skills.

10. Proofread the finished resume before submitting it.



Each significant opportunity should receive an appropriately tailored resume rather than sending the exact same generic resume everywhere.



---



## 3. Job Applications



Manage the application process from beginning to end.



Responsibilities include:



- Completing applications

- Uploading the correct tailored resume

- Completing standard screening questions

- Maintaining accurate applicant information

- Saving job descriptions when necessary

- Recording application confirmation

- Tracking next steps

- Monitoring deadlines

- Preventing duplicate applications



Approximately 10 qualified applications should be completed per business day.



Applications requiring unusual legal declarations, salary commitments, assessments, recorded video responses, lengthy personality tests, contracts, or information that has not already been authorized should be flagged for me rather than guessed.



---



## 4. Application Tracking



Maintain a master Job Search Tracker.



Each application should include:



- Company

- Position

- Industry

- Location

- Remote/hybrid/on-site

- Salary or compensation range

- Job URL

- Source

- Date discovered

- Date applied

- Resume version used

- Application status

- Recruiter/hiring manager

- Contact information

- Follow-up date

- Interview date

- Interview stage

- Next action

- Notes

- Rejection/offer status



Application stages should be standardized, such as:



**Found → Reviewed → Approved → Resume Tailored → Applied → Follow-Up Due → Recruiter Contact → Interview → Final Interview → Offer / Rejected / Closed**



---



## 5. Follow-Ups



Do not allow submitted applications to simply disappear after submission.



Create and maintain a follow-up system.



Examples:



- Initial recruiter/hiring manager outreach

- Application follow-up

- Interview thank-you

- Interview follow-up

- Networking follow-up

- Mentorship follow-up

- Meeting follow-up



Track when each follow-up should happen and alert me when my involvement is required.



---



## 6. Professional Networking & Mentorship



Regularly research professionals I could learn from or build relationships with.



Priority industries include:



- E-commerce

- TikTok Shop/social commerce

- Influencer marketing

- Creator management

- Music business

- Artist management

- Music marketing

- Sales

- Business development

- AI

- Entrepreneurship

- Partnerships



Potential contacts may include:



- Executives

- Founders

- Directors

- Managers

- Experienced operators

- Sales leaders

- E-commerce professionals

- Creator managers

- Music executives

- Industry consultants



The objective is relationship building and mentorship—not mass spam.



For each strong contact:



1. Research their background.

2. Determine why the person is relevant to my goals.

3. Identify a legitimate point of connection.

4. Draft a personalized outreach message.

5. Track the outreach.

6. Schedule an appropriate follow-up.

7. Record responses and meetings.



Quality is more important than sending hundreds of generic messages.



---



## 7. Calendar & Schedule Management



Help manage my:



- Interviews

- Professional meetings

- Mentorship calls

- Business meetings

- Appointments

- Personal commitments

- Work obligations

- Deadlines

- Follow-ups

- Projects



Before adding or recommending a commitment, check my existing schedule.



The goal is not to fill every available hour.



My schedule should remain realistic and sustainable.



Consider:



- Travel time

- Preparation time

- Work commitments

- Business responsibilities

- Personal obligations

- Meals

- Sleep

- Recovery time

- Transition time between meetings

- Existing priorities



Flag scheduling conflicts before they become a problem.



---



## 8. Daily Executive Summary



At the end of each workday, send me a concise executive summary containing:



### Applications

- Jobs found

- Jobs applied to

- Companies

- Positions

- Important opportunities requiring my attention



### Follow-Ups

- Follow-ups completed

- Follow-ups due tomorrow

- Responses received



### Networking

- Professionals researched

- Outreach sent

- Responses

- Meetings scheduled



### Calendar

- Tomorrow's appointments

- Interviews

- Meetings

- Deadlines



### Action Required From Me

Clearly identify anything that requires my personal involvement.



Example:



**ACTION REQUIRED**

1. Complete assessment for Company A.

2. Review interview invitation from Company B.

3. Approve outreach message to executive at Company C.



---



## 9. Weekly Executive Check-In



At the beginning of each week, ask:



**"What are your goals and plans for this week?"**



Then help translate those goals into an achievable weekly schedule.



Review:



- Career priorities

- Job-search targets

- Interviews

- Networking goals

- Business priorities

- Personal obligations

- Appointments

- Deadlines

- Unfinished tasks from the previous week



The weekly plan should be realistic rather than overloaded.



---



# Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured by organization and quality—not simply hours worked.



Key expectations include:



- Approximately 10 qualified job applications per business day

- Approximately 50 qualified applications per week when sufficient opportunities exist

- Applications accurately tracked

- No duplicate applications

- Resume customized when appropriate

- No fabricated resume information

- Important follow-ups completed on time

- Interviews and appointments properly tracked

- Schedule conflicts identified in advance

- Professional networking conducted consistently

- Daily summaries delivered consistently

- Weekly planning completed consistently



---



# Required Skills



The ideal candidate should be strong in:



- Online research

- Google Docs

- Google Sheets

- Google Calendar

- Gmail/email management

- LinkedIn

- Job boards

- ChatGPT/AI tools

- Resume editing

- Written English

- Professional communication

- Scheduling

- Organization

- Attention to detail

- Independent problem solving



You should be comfortable learning new AI tools and workflows.



Experience with recruiting, job-search assistance, executive assistance, sales recruiting, sourcing, LinkedIn outreach, career services, or business development is highly valuable.



---



# What I Do NOT Want



I am not looking for someone who:



- Blindly submits Easy Apply applications

- Uses the same resume for everything

- Mass-spams professionals

- Fabricates information with AI

- Applies to clearly unqualified jobs just to hit a quota

- Requires instructions for every small decision

- Loses track of follow-ups

- Overbooks my calendar

- Says a task is complete without verifying it

- Uses AI output without reviewing it



I want someone who can operate like an executive assistant and project manager.



---



# Ideal Personality



You are:



- Extremely organized

- Proactive

- Detail-oriented

- Reliable

- Curious

- Resourceful

- Comfortable with technology

- Comfortable asking questions when information truly cannot be determined

- Capable of following detailed systems

- Able to notice inconsistencies

- Able to prioritize independently



Most importantly, you should be capable of thinking:



**"What needs to happen next?"**



instead of waiting for me to assign every next step.



---



# Application Instructions



When applying, please include:



1. Your executive/virtual assistant experience.

2. Your experience applying to jobs for clients.

3. Your experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT.

4. Your experience with Google Docs and Sheets.

5. Your experience with LinkedIn research/outreach.

6. An example of a system you have used to manage recurring tasks or follow-ups.

7. Your weekly availability.

8. Your time zone.

9. Your desired hourly or monthly rate.



Please begin your application with the phrase:



**"Career Operations"**



so I know you carefully read the description.

title: Outbound Sales Rep / Appointment Setter — US Retirement Calls — Night Shift (PH, WFH)
description:
What the job actually is



This is an outbound sales role. You are on the phone all shift.



We call people in the United States who filled in a form about retirement income and life insurance. Most of them will not remember filling it in. Your job is to open the call, explain who we are and why we are calling, get them interested enough to keep talking, ask the questions that tell you whether they fit what our client is looking for, and then hand the good ones live to a licensed agent.



You sell the conversation. You never sell the product.



That one line is the whole job. You have to create enough interest that a stranger agrees to speak with an agent. What you never do is discuss the product itself: no recommending it, no quoting a rate or a return, no telling anybody whether they should buy. You are not licensed and you will not be. Every product question gets the same answer, warmly: "That's exactly what the licensed agent will walk you through on the call."



If you have sold anything over the phone before, the skill transfers. If you have only ever read scripts and logged outcomes, this will be harder than you expect.



We are Apex Digital Media, a Florida company. On calls you use our brand name, Summers Ahead.



The hours



9:00am to 6:00pm US Eastern Time, Monday to Saturday.



In Manila that is 9:00pm to 6:00am. From early November to mid March it shifts to 10:00pm to 7:00am, when the US changes its clocks.



This is a permanent night shift. Our consumers are in the United States and you can only legally call them during their day. There is no night differential and no rotation onto days later. If a permanent night schedule does not work for your life, this is not the job.



The pay, in full

$5.00 USD per hour, for every hour you work

$3 for every transfer the client accepts. $4 each once you pass 10 accepted in a week, $5 each once you pass 20. Resets every week

$15 bonus in any week where at least 10 transfers are accepted and 80% or more of your transfers are accepted

Paid every two weeks in USD. The period closes Saturday 11:59 PM ET and you are paid the following Friday

Your first payment lands 6 to 19 days after your first shift, depending which day of the cycle you start on



A typical week at 40 hours and 15 accepted transfers is around $265.



Read this part twice. Transfer pay is on transfers the client accepts, not transfers you make. Connect somebody in the wrong state, well outside the income range, or who did not really understand what the call was, and the client rejects it. A rejected transfer pays nothing. If it was already paid, it comes off your next period. That is a clawback and it will happen to you at some point.



Your hourly base is never touched by any of this. It is for your time, and your time was worked.



This is why pressure does not pay here. Three accepted transfers a day beats ten that fall apart, and three a day is what moves you into the higher rate tier.



The hard parts, so you can d
 now



You are starting most calls cold, from a standing start. "I never signed up for anything" is something you will hear many times a day. You need to be able to explain calmly what they filled in and re-earn the conversation. If somebody genuinely does not remember, or asks you to stop, you take them off the list and end the call. You do not argue them into it.



Most dials go nowhere. New hires work the oldest, hardest lists for their first two weeks. That is where you learn the script without burning good leads. It is normal for the first fortnight to feel like nothing is working.



Your pay moves with quality, in both directions. Up with accepted transfers, down when they are rejected.



We track time with Hubstaff, which records your hours and takes periodic screenshots and activity readings while you are on shift. You are being told this now, before you apply, rather than after you accept.



Your first two weeks are a trial. At the end of it you either join the team properly or we stop. You are told exactly what is measured on day one, with check-ins at day 3, day 7 and day 14. Nothing about it is a surprise.



If you have read this far and still want it, you are the person we want to interview.



What we are looking for



Someone who can take a stranger who did not expect the call and turn it into a real conversation. That takes warmth, quick thinking, and the willingness to keep going after the first brush-off.



It does not take pressure. There are two ways to fail this job and both are common. One is reading the script and accepting the first no. The other is talking somebody onto the line who did not want to be there, which gets the transfer rejected, costs you the pay, and costs us the client. The skill is the middle: persuasive about the call, never pushy about the person.



Outbound sales, telemarketing or collections experience all help. Insurance experience is genuinely not needed. We teach that part.



What you need

Clear spoken English. Our consumers are 55 and older and they need to understand you the first time

A wired USB headset with a microphone

A computer that can run a dialer and two browser tabs without struggling

Internet at 25 Mbps down and 10 up minimum, wired preferred, and a plan for when the power goes

A quiet room with a door

Able to work 11:00am to 7:00pm ET, Monday to Saturday

The process

One form, about ten minutes, ending with a 60-second voice recording: [FORM LINK]

We score it and reply either way

A 20-minute video interview. Ten minutes of it is a role-play where you open a call and handle two objections. We send you the script in advance

An offer, then paid training from day one



We reply to everyone who submits a voice sample.



How to apply







To show you read this, start your recording with the word SUMMERS.

ABOUT N & K REAL ESTATE MEDIA

The starting position will focus primarily on Quality Control (QC) and Delivery, but this position is intended to grow into a larger role as you become familiar with our systems, standards, and workflow.



Our goal is to develop someone who can eventually take on a lead role within the VA side of our company.



STARTING POSITION: QC & DELIVERY

Your primary responsibility will be to make sure completed photo and video projects meet our quality standards before they are delivered to clients.



You will:

* Download completed projects from our editing platforms.

* Review completed photos and videos for quality and consistency.

* Perform quality control before projects are delivered.

* Make corrections when necessary.

* Upload and organize completed projects in our client delivery system.

* Verify that all services ordered by the client have been completed and delivered.

* Add drone pinpoints above homes in aerial images when required.

* Communicate with editors regarding corrections and revisions.

* Communicate through SMS,
, Slack, Instagram, and other platforms as needed.

* Respond promptly and professionally to messages.

* Make sure projects are delivered accurately and on time.



PHOTO QUALITY CONTROL

We use Auto HDR, an AI-powered photo editing system, as part of our editing workflow.



However, AI does not replace the need for an experienced photo editor.



You will be responsible for carefully reviewing the completed Auto HDR images and identifying anything the AI may have missed or incorrectly edited.



This includes checking for:

* Incorrect or inconsistent color

* Exposure problems

* White balance issues

* Unnatural HDR results

* Editing inconsistencies

* Items that should have been removed

* Grass or landscaping issues

* TV screen replacements

* Bracketed photo editing issues

* Other visual problems that do not meet our standards



You may also need to compare the edited image against the original RAW files to determine whether the final image accurately represents the property.



It is extremely important that you have a strong eye for detail and consistency.



Our goal is not simply to deliver images that have been processed by AI. Our goal is to deliver images that meet the N & K Real Estate Media standard.



ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

As you become comfortable with QC and delivery, additional responsibilities may be assigned, including:



Client Communication

* Responding to client
s and text messages.

* Assisting with client communication and follow-up.

* Helping with client acquisition activities.

* Instagram Method



During available time, you may assist with our social media outreach strategy by:

* Liking posts.

* Commenting on posts.

* Engaging with real estate agents.

* Following potential clients.

* Performing other Instagram outreach activities.



Virtual Assistant Tasks

Additional administrative, organizational, research, communication, or operational tasks may be assigned as needed.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You should have:

* Strong written and spoken English.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong organizational skills.

* Experience with Adobe Photoshop.

* Experience with Adobe Lightroom.

* Experience reviewing and editing photographs.

* The ability to identify subtle color and editing problems.

* The ability to follow detailed instructions and company standards.

* Reliable communication and responsiveness.

* A fast and stable internet connection.

* A reliable computer capable of handling photo editing.

title: Screen Recording Tutorial Producer — $1 Per Completed Video | Up to $1,300+/Month
description:
Screen Recording Tutorial Producer — $1 Per Completed Video | Up to $1,300+/Month



💰 Potential to Earn $260–$1,300+ Per Month



I'm looking for reliable people who can produce short screen-recording tutorial videos for my YouTube channels.



You are paid $1 for every completed, upload-ready video.



There can be 10–50 videos available per day, depending on the workload.



That means your potential daily earnings can be:



- 10 videos = $10/day

- 20 videos = $20/day

- 30 videos = $30/day

- 40 videos = $40/day

- 50 videos = $50/day



If you work around 26 days per month, that's approximately $260–$1,300/month, depending on how many completed videos you produce.



There is no fixed requirement to complete 50 videos every day. You d
 how much work you can realistically handle while maintaining quality.



THE JOB



I run YouTube channels that publish short how-to and tutorial videos about software, websites, apps, AI tools, and online platforms.



I'm building a high-volume production system and looking for people who can turn a provided voiceover into a finished tutorial video that is ready to upload immediately.



This is not a script-writing job.



This is not a research job.



You don't need to create thumbnails.



You don't need to record your voice.



I provide the voiceover. You create the finished screen-recording tutorial.



HOW THE WORKS WORK



For each video, I provide only:



1. The video title/topic



2. The finished voiceover audio



Your job is to take those two things and produce the complete video.



The workflow is:



Listen to the voiceover → Open the software → Figure out the current interface → Perform the steps → Record the screen → Synchronize everything → Export → Deliver



That's it.



I intentionally do not provide a long click-by-click recording guide.



The voiceover explains what the viewer needs to do.



You figure out how to perform those actions in the current version of the software.



---



YOU MUST BE ABLE TO NAVIGATE SOFTWARE YOURSELF



This is the most important part of the job.



For example, the voiceover might say:



«"Open Settings, go to Privacy, and turn off this option."»



You should be able to open the application, find Settings, locate Privacy, find the option, and record the process.



If the software has been updated and the button has moved, find the new location yourself.



You do not need to know every application beforehand.



You need to be comfortable exploring software and figuring things out.



I'm looking for someone who can receive a voiceover and think:



"Okay, I understand what needs to happen. Let me find it."



rather than:



"Where exactly do I click?"



---



REFERENCE CHANNEL



There is one permanent reference for the style I want.



Study this channel before applying:



"JustAskJake — YouTube" (
)



You should watch several videos and understand how the tutorials are presented.



I will not send a separate reference video for every assignment.



The channel is the reference.



Once you understand the style, you should be able to reproduce it consistently across different topics.



---



WHAT "COMPLETED VIDEO" MEANS



This is very important.



You are paid for a completed video, not raw screen-recording footage.



When you submit a video, it should be something I can download and upload to YouTube immediately.



I should not have to:



- Re-record anything

- Fix synchronization

- Remove obvious mistakes

- Finish missing steps

- Clean up the screen

- Edit major sections

- Figure out what you were trying to show



You are responsible for delivering the finished tutorial.



If you make a mistake during recording, simply redo that section before submitting.



---



VIDEO REQUIREMENTS



Videos should generally be:



- 1080p

- MP4

- 24–30 FPS

- Clean screen recording

- Properly synchronized with the voiceover

- Easy to follow

- Free of unnecessary pauses

- Free of obvious recording mistakes

- Free of personal information



Do not show:



- Passwords

- Private messages

- Personal documents

- Banking information

- Personal
s

- Notifications

- Other private information



Use demo/test accounts where appropriate.



---



EDITING



These are simple tutorial videos.



You are not expected to create complicated cinematic edits, animations, or motion graphics.



The focus is on making the tutorial clear and professional.



The important things are:



The right screen → the right action → at the right time → with the right result.



---



SOFTWARE YOU MAY WORK WITH



Topics can include:



- Windows 11

- Microsoft Edge

- Google Chrome

- VLC Media Player

- 7-Zip

- OBS Studio

- Adobe Acrobat

- Gmail

- Google Drive

- 

- WhatsApp

- Canva

- Figma

- Notion

- VS Code

- AI tools

- SaaS platforms

- Websites

- Browser extensions

- Desktop applications

- Mobile applications



You do not need to already know all of these.



The ability to learn and navigate unfamiliar software is more important.



---



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



You should be:



- Comfortable using computers

- Good at learning software

- Able to understand spoken English

- Comfortable recording your screen

- Independent

- Detail-oriented

- Fast but accurate

- Reliable

- Able to follow a voiceover precisely

- Comfortable doing repetitive work

- Interested in long-term work



You don't need years of professional video-production experience.



If you can use a computer confidently and learn software quickly, you can do this job.



---



DAILY WORKLOAD



There can be 10–50 videos available per day.



Your actual workload is up to you.



For example:



10 videos → $10



25 videos → $25



50 videos → $50



If you are able to consistently produce a large number of good-quality videos, there can be substantial ongoing work.



Speed matters, but quality comes first.



I would rather receive 20 excellent completed videos than 50 videos that require corrections.



---



PAID TEST



Before receiving regular work, shortlisted applicants will complete one paid test video.



I will provide:



- A title/topic

- The voiceover



You will create the complete upload-ready tutorial.



The test allows me to evaluate:



- Your ability to understand the voiceover

- Your ability to navigate software

- Screen-recording quality

- Timing and synchronization

- Attention to detail

- Ability to reproduce the reference style

- Overall reliability



If the test is good, we can move to regular batches.



---



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer the following questions:



1. What computer/device do you use for recording?



2. What operating system do you use?



3. What screen-recording and editing software do you use?



4. How many completed videos can you realistically produce per day?



5. Have you created screen-recording tutorials before?



If yes, send examples.



6. How many hours per day are you available?



7. What would you do if the voiceover describes a button or setting, but the software's current interface has moved it somewhere else?



8. Watch several videos from the reference channel above and briefly explain what you think is important about its recording style.



And one small test to make sure you actually read this post:



Begin your proposal with the word "CompleteVideo".



---



IMPORTANT



This is intended to be long-term, high-volume work.



The workflow is deliberately simple:



I give you the title + voiceover.



You figure out the software + record the tutorial + deliver the finished video.



If you are independent, fast, accurate, and comfortable learning new software, there can be a lot of work available.



$1 per completed video.



10–50 videos can be available per day.



Potential earnings of approximately $260–$1,300+ per month depending on your output and working days.



If you're interested, apply with CompleteVideo at the beginning of your proposal.

title: Operations & Marketing Virtual Assistant
description:
Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity | European Business



We are looking for a highly organised, reliable and tech-confident Virtual Assistant to support the operations of a growing premium health and wellness company based in Iceland.



This is not primarily a customer service or social media role.



We are looking for someone who enjoys systems, organisation, data, processes and getting things done accurately.



You will work closely with the CEO and our operations team to help make the business more organised, automated and efficient.



What You’ll Be Working On



Your responsibilities may include:



* Updating and maintaining information across our business systems

* Booking-system administration and quality checks

* Shopify order and customer administration

* Supporting our migration and setup in Pabau

* Updating our internal handbook and SOP system

* Preparing spreadsheets, reports and performance data

* Supporting monthly staff performance reporting

* Preparing payroll/time reconciliation data for approval

* Setting up and updating landing pages

* Setting up
 campaigns from approved copy/templates

* Updating website banners, offers, products and discount codes

* Preparing recurring campaigns using previous campaigns and templates

* Uploading and organising content and files

* Performing routine operational checks

* Research and data entry

* Using AI tools such as ChatGPT to work faster and improve processes

* Helping us identify repetitive work that could be automated

    Designing polished marketing materials in Canva based on our existing brand guidelines

* Creating and adapting social media graphics, website banners,
 graphics and campaign materials

* Working from approved messaging/copy — you will not be expected to write our core marketing copy

* Maintaining consistent visual branding across materials

* Using previous campaigns and templates to create new campaign assets efficiently

* Basic image editing and preparation of visual assets for web,
 and social media.



Over time, we want this person to become someone we can trust to own recurring operational processes without constant supervision.



Who We’re Looking For



You are likely a good fit if you:



* Have excellent written and spoken English

* Are extremely organised and detail-oriented

* Are comfortable learning new software quickly

* Are confident working with spreadsheets and data

* Follow SOPs accurately

* Notice mistakes before they become problems

Design Skills Are Important



You should be:



* Highly confident in Canva

* Able to create clean, premium and professional marketing materials

* Comfortable working within established brand guidelines rather than redesigning the brand

* Able to take an existing design and adapt it beautifully across multiple formats

* Detail-oriented with typography, spacing, alignment and visual consistency

* Able to understand the difference between a polished premium brand and generic template-based design



A good visual eye is important for this role.



You do not need to be a professional graphic designer, but you should be significantly stronger in Canva and visual execution than the average general VA.



Hours & Working Arrangement



Initially approximately 15–20 hours per week, with the possibility of developing into a larger long-term role.



Most work can be completed flexibly, but we need some overlap with Iceland/UK working hours for communication and handovers.



This is a remote contractor position.



About Us



The House of Beauty is an established premium health and body clinic based in Reykjavík, Iceland.



We are currently redesigning our operations to become increasingly systemised, automated and less dependent on manual administration.



For the right person, this is an opportunity to become an important part of that transformation rather than simply completing a list of isolated VA tasks.



How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your previous VA/operations experience.

2. Examples of systems or software you have worked with.

3. Your experience with spreadsheets, AI tools and automation.

4. Your current availability and expected monthly salary/rate for approximately 15–20 hours per week.

5. An example of a repetitive administrative process you have improved or made more efficient in a previous role.

6. A link to 3–5 examples of marketing materials you have personally designed in Canva.



Please start your application with the words “THOB SYSTEMS” so we know you have read the full job post.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term working relationship and who can grow in responsibility as trust and experience develop.

title: CRO Specialist / Growth Designer (A/B Testing)
description:
We are a growing DTC e-commerce group and are hiring one person to own our conversion program: build product pages, landing pages, and offers, A/B test them, read the data, and ship the winners, every week. You will work directly with the founders, our media buyer, and our ad creative team. We have enough traffic to run several real tests every month, so you will see results fast. 



This is not a "make it look pretty" job. We care about revenue per visitor.



What You Will Do:

Build pages and funnels:

- Design product pages, advertorials / pre-landers, listicles, bundle pages, and upsell / cross-sell flows

- Build landing pages that match the ad angles that are scaling 

- Set up post-purchase upsells, the cart drawer, and checkout settings

- Keep a library of proven page templates and sections



Design and test offers:

- Test bundles, tiered pricing, quantity breaks, free-gift and free-shipping thresholds, and discount framing

- Run price and offer tests

- Calculate the margin impact before any offer goes live, no offer ships without a profit-per-order calculation



Run A/B tests:

- Keep a prioritized test backlog (hypothesis, expected impact, effort)

- Launch multiple tests per week, each with a written hypothesis and a clear success metric

- Calculate sample size before launch and run tests to statistical significance

- Keep a test log: what changed, dates, traffic, result, decision, learning

- Roll out winners everywhere they apply; document losers so we never re-test them



Analyze:

- Weekly review Shopify analytics: funnel drop-off by step, device, traffic source, landing page

- Review heatmaps and session recordings to find friction

- Mine customer support tickets, reviews, and surveys for objections and copy angles

- Monthly competitor check (pages and offers)



Report: 

- Weekly report: tests running, tests finished, results, next launches, RPV / CVR / AOV trend

- Monthly report: total lift, learnings, next month's backlog, recommendations for ads and creative

- Tell the media buyer which landers get traffic and at what split; feed winning hooks and objections back to the creative team



Your KPIs:

- Revenue per visitor 

- Profit per visitor / margin per order

- Conversion rate and AOV 

- Tests launched per month and win rate

- Add-to-cart rate and checkout completion rate



Requirements: 

- Experience building Shopify pages for e-commerce brands (DTC, dropshipping, or CRO / e-commerce agency)

- Built advertorials / pre-landers matched to specific ad angles

- You have run real A/B tests and can show results with numbers (CVR, RPV, AOV), including tests that lost

- You have run at least one price or offer test

- Comfortable with GA4, Shopify analytics, and Clarity

- You can explain sample size and statistical significance in simple words

- Good understanding of direct-response basics: hook, proof, objections, urgency

- Strong written English; clear, short reports

- Reliable internet, a good computer, and a quiet workspace

- Shopify Liquid / theme development knowledge



What We Offer:

- Full-time, long-term remote position

- Salary depending on experience, with room for increases based on results

- Real traffic, real budget, and real ownership of the test program

- Direct access to the founder, fast decisions, no bureaucracy

- Room to grow as the team grows



How to Apply:

1) Send your CV

2) 3 to 5 A/B tests you have run, at least one that LOST. For each test, include:

- Context: niche, page type, and rough traffic (sessions/day or orders/day)

- What data gave you the idea (heatmap, drop-off, survey, reviews, tickets)

- Your hypothesis in one sentence

- What you changed (control vs. variant, screenshots or a Loom are welcome as support)

- Tool used, traffic split, how long it ran, and sample size

- Result: CVR / RPV / AOV before and after, and whether it reached significance

- Decision: rolled out, killed, or iterated, and what you learned

You can hide brand names for NDA reasons. Relative numbers (for example "+11% RPV") are required.

3) Links to 2–3 live pages you built

4) A short answer to this question: "Tell us about a test you were sure would win, and it lost. What did you learn?"

5) A screenshot of a test log or weekly report you keep (redacted is fine)

6) If possible, a 3–5 minute Loom video walking us through one of your tests



Applications with no screenshots and no numbers will not be considered.

title: U.S. Bookkeeping & Accounting Professional
description:
Immediate Opening



We are looking for a full-time accounting professional in the Philippines who wants to build a long-term career working with U.S.-based clients.



This position is a little different from a typical bookkeeping role, so please read the entire description before applying.



What the Role Looks Like



For the first 1 to 3 months, a significant part of this position will involve high-volume data entry for one U.S. client.



This client processes a large number of transactions, potentially 50 to 100+ invoices per day, across both accounts payable and accounts receivable. You need to be comfortable working accurately and efficiently with this level of volume.



We want to be very clear about this upfront. If you dislike repetitive, high-volume transaction entry, this probably isn't the right position for you.



However, the position will not stay this way.



We are actively working to automate much of this process. Sales and AR activity will eventually flow from ServiceTitan into the accounting system, and AP invoices will increasingly be processed using OCR and automation tools.



As those systems are implemented, your role will shift from primarily entering transactions to reviewing transactions, monitoring automated processes, bookkeeping, reconciliations, and working with additional U.S. clients.



Our expectation is that this position will eventually support approximately 3 to 5 U.S. clients, starting with our less complicated accounts. As your skills and knowledge grow, there will be opportunities to take on more complex accounting responsibilities.



What We're Looking For



We would especially like to hear from candidates who have:



* Experience working directly with U.S.-based clients, preferably multiple clients

* Strong experience with QuickBooks Online

* Experience with bookkeeping, bank reconciliations, AP and AR

* Experience processing a high volume of invoices or other financial transactions

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy

* The ability to work efficiently with repetitive tasks without sacrificing quality

* Good written and verbal English communication skills

* A reliable, high-speed internet connection and dependable home work environment

* An interest in learning new accounting systems and technology

* A genuine interest in working with and eventually supporting multiple U.S. businesses



Experience with ServiceTitan would be a major plus, but it is not required.



Work Schedule



This is a full-time, 8-hour-per-day position working U.S. hours.



Your regular workday will end at 2:00 AM Pacific Time, so please make sure you are comfortable working this schedule on a long-term basis before applying.



We strongly prefer candidates who have previously worked a night or graveyard schedule for U.S. clients and already know that this schedule works for them.



Where This Position Can Go



We're not looking for someone just to enter invoices.



We're looking for someone who can handle the high-volume work required at the beginning, learn our clients and systems, and then grow into a broader accounting and bookkeeping role.



As we automate the repetitive work, we want to give you more responsibility and expose you to additional U.S. clients. For someone who wants to develop their U.S. accounting experience, there is significant room to grow.



How to Apply



Please submit both of the following:



1. Your resume

2. A short video introduction, approximately 1 minute



In your video, please briefly tell us:



* Your accounting/bookkeeping background

* How much experience you have working with U.S. clients

* The highest volume of invoices or transactions you've handled

* Whether you've previously worked a U.S. night/graveyard schedule

* Why you're interested in working with more U.S.-based clients



Applications without both a resume and video will not be considered.

bottom are deleted without a reply. We are not being rude - we have hired before and we are

Raber HVAC - heating, cooling, plumbing and electrical in Cleveland, Ohio. Real company,

PAY

uncapped monthly commission on what the office produces. A strong person here clears

2,500 to 3,000 a month. There is no ceiling on the commission - that is the whole point.

=====================================================================

THE THREE REQUIREMENTS - NO EXCEPTIONS

=====================================================================

   You will be on the phone with American homeowners all day. They must never have to ask you

   - proof of BACKUP POWER (UPS or battery that keeps your router and computer alive)

=====================================================================



HOW TO APPLY

Reply with: (1) your voice recording, (2) your ServiceTitan / US home-services history with

company names and dates, (3) your internet and power proof, (4) the monthly number you need

title: Real Estate Acquisition & Seller Solutions Closer – Listings, Cash Offers & Online Auctions
description:
REAL ESTATE ACQUISITION & SELLER SOLUTIONS CLOSER  

Listings • Cash Offers • Competitive Online Sales • Auctions



We are building a different kind of real estate seller-conversion platform and looking for an experienced **Real Estate Acquisition / Seller Solutions Closer** who can speak confidently with U.S. property owners and help them determine the best way to sell.



This position is for someone who understands that **not every motivated seller should be forced into a wholesale cash offer.**



Depending on the seller's goals, property, equity, condition, timing, and price expectations, we may be able to offer several different solutions.



Our goal is simple:



**Understand what the seller is trying to accomplish and move them toward the best available solution.**



### OUR PLATFORMS



Our seller and competitive-sale programs include:



**Realty Offers Now**  

Our seller-facing real estate marketplace and seller-solutions platform.



**
**  

Our competitive online bidding platform used for online real estate sales and auction-style transactions.



**Seller Options Now**  

Our motivated-seller platform for direct purchase opportunities and alternative seller solutions.



Our business combines traditional real estate, investor acquisitions, seller lead conversion, and competitive online bidding.



### SELLER SOLUTIONS MAY INCLUDE



Depending upon the seller and property:



- Direct cash / investor purchase

- Traditional real estate listing

- Competitive online bidding

- Real estate auction

- Offer-to-Sold competitive-sale strategy

- Accelerated sale

- Other structured seller solutions

- Continued follow-up and nurture when the seller is not ready today



We are looking for someone who can recognize the difference between these opportunities and confidently explain the appropriate solution to the seller.



### THIS IS A CLOSING POSITION



This is NOT primarily an appointment-setting position.



Our lead-generation team identifies and contacts property owners.



You will work primarily with:



- Interested sellers

- Warm seller leads

- Previously contacted property owners

- Sellers requesting offers

- Aged leads requiring re-engagement

- Property owners considering a Realtor

- Sellers whose price does not fit a traditional investor acquisition

- Sellers who may benefit from an accelerated or competitive-sale strategy

- Real estate agents who may have properties appropriate for our online bidding platform



Your responsibility is to **advance the opportunity.**



### YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Speak with warm U.S. property-owner leads

- Build rapport and trust quickly

- Determine the seller's true motivation

- Understand timing and urgency

- Discuss property condition

- Determine price expectations

- Discuss mortgage/equity information when appropriate

- Identify decision-makers

- Present and discuss potential selling solutions

- Handle seller objections

- Negotiate purchase opportunities

- Discuss realistic property values and expectations

- Recognize when a cash acquisition is NOT the right solution

- Transition qualified sellers toward a traditional listing when appropriate

- Explain competitive online sale and auction options

- Follow up persistently with sellers who are not ready immediately

- Ask for clear commitments and next steps

- Maintain detailed CRM records

- Coordinate qualified opportunities with management and licensed real estate professionals

- Help move seller opportunities toward signed agreements and completed transactions



### THE PERSON WE WANT



We are especially interested in candidates who have previously worked as:



- Acquisition Manager

- Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist

- Seller Lead Manager

- Real Estate Sales Closer

- Disposition Manager

- Wholesale Acquisition Manager

- Inside Sales Agent

- Listing Conversion Specialist

- Real Estate Investor VA with closing responsibilities

- Real Estate Sales Manager

- Lead Conversion Manager



Experience working with **U.S. motivated property sellers is strongly preferred.**



### DIRECT REAL ESTATE CLOSING EXPERIENCE IS HIGHLY VALUED



We want to hear from candidates who have personally:



- Presented offers to homeowners

- Discussed purchase prices

- Negotiated with sellers

- Handled price objections

- Followed sellers over multiple conversations

- Obtained purchase agreements

- Helped obtain listing agreements

- Worked transactions from lead through contract

- Coordinated closings

- Worked acquisitions and/or dispositions



If your only real estate experience is reading a cold-calling script and scheduling appointments, this is probably not the right position.



### MULTIPLE-SOLUTION SELLING



One of the most important parts of this role is recognizing that not every seller belongs in the same box.



For example:



A seller who needs immediate certainty and has a property requiring major repairs may be appropriate for a direct purchase.



A seller who wants closer to full market value may be better suited for a traditional listing.



A property where competitive buyer demand may produce a better result could be appropriate for a competitive online sale through RealtyBidNow.



A seller who wants market exposure but also wants a defined selling timeline may be appropriate for our Offer-to-Sold strategy.



Your job is to ask enough questions to determine the appropriate direction.



### REALTOR / AGENT OPPORTUNITIES



This position may also involve conversations with real estate agents.



RealtyBidNow can be used as an additional selling tool for agents who have clients or properties that may benefit from a competitive online sale or accelerated-sale strategy.



We cooperate with real estate professionals rather than attempting to remove them from the transaction.



Depending upon the opportunity and written agreement:



- The referring/listing agent may remain involved with their seller

- The agent remains informed and included

- Property marketing is coordinated collaboratively

- Photography and property presentation remain important

- Agent participation and referrals may be compensated according to the specific written agreement

- Our online bidding platform can become an additional tool for the agent and their client



You must be comfortable speaking professionally with both homeowners and real estate professionals.



### CRM EXPERIENCE



Experience with real estate CRM systems is important.



**Follow Up Boss experience is strongly preferred, but it is NOT mandatory for an otherwise exceptional acquisition closer.**



Experience with any of the following is valuable:



- Follow Up Boss

- Podio

- GoHighLevel

- InvestorFuse

- REISimpli

- REI BlackBook

- REI Reply

- Salesforce

- HubSpot

- Pipedrive

- LionDesk



You must be comfortable managing:



- Lead stages

- Notes

- Tasks

- Follow-up

- Pipelines

- Calls

- Text messages

- Email communication

- Long-term nurture

- Detailed seller histories



### TYPES OF SELLERS YOU MAY SPEAK WITH



- Inherited / estate property owners

- Tired landlords

- Absentee owners

- Vacant-property owners

- Properties needing significant repairs

- Pre-foreclosure owners

- Owners experiencing financial pressure

- Sellers relocating

- Investors

- Owners of rental property

- Commercial property owners

- Landowners

- Sellers with unrealistic price expectations

- Sellers considering traditional Realtors

- Sellers who already received investor offers

- Sellers who need weeks or months of follow-up before d



### COMMUNICATION STYLE



We do NOT want a robotic script reader.



You should be:



- Confident

- Professional

- Conversational

- Curious

- Persistent

- Comfortable discussing money

- Comfortable asking difficult questions

- Able to listen

- Able to challenge assumptions respectfully

- Able to control a sales conversation without being aggressive



Excellent spoken English is required.



### COMPENSATION



Expected base compensation:



**$1,000–$2,500 USD per month depending on experience**



We are especially interested in creating a compensation structure that rewards results.



Qualified candidates may receive:



- Base compensation

- Performance bonuses

- Signed-agreement bonuses

- Transaction bonuses

- Closing incentives

- Other performance-based compensation



The exact structure will depend upon the candidate's experience and role.



Exceptional performance may lead to increased responsibility in seller conversion, acquisition management, sales operations, or team leadership.



### WORKING HOURS



Approximately **30–40 hours per week**.



You must have meaningful overlap with **U.S. Eastern Time**, including normal daytime seller-contact hours.



This is intended to become a long-term position.



### REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



- Reliable computer

- High-speed internet

- Quiet professional workspace

- Quality microphone/headset

- Ability to participate in video meetings

- Reliable availability during agreed U.S. hours

- Backup internet or power solution strongly preferred



### HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with:



**“I ADVANCE REAL ESTATE DEALS”**



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be reviewed.



Then answer the following questions.



1. How many years have you worked in U.S. real estate?



2. Describe your experience personally speaking with motivated property sellers.



3. What was your most recent real estate position?



4. Were you personally responsible for negotiating with sellers and obtaining contracts, or did you primarily set appointments for someone else?



5. Walk us through one actual seller transaction you personally helped move from initial conversation through offer, negotiation, contract, and closing.



6. Approximately how many seller leads did you personally handle each week or month?



7. Approximately how many purchase agreements, listings, or other signed seller opportunities did you personally generate in an average month?



8. Describe your experience running comps, calculating ARV, estimating repairs, or determining offer prices.



9. Describe your experience with acquisitions and dispositions.



10. Which CRM systems have you personally used?



11. Have you used Follow Up Boss? If yes, explain exactly how you used it. If not, tell us which real estate CRM you know best.



12. A seller wants $275,000. Your direct purchase number is approximately $200,000. The seller is not distressed and says they would rather list the property than accept $200,000. What would you do next?



13. Have you ever worked with traditional listings, auctions, competitive online sales, novations, seller financing, or other alternative real estate sale methods? Explain.



14. Are you comfortable speaking with Realtors and real estate brokers about referring or cooperating on seller opportunities?



15. What hours can you consistently work in U.S. Eastern Time?



16. What base hourly or monthly compensation are you requesting?



17. Would you consider a base compensation plus performance bonuses or commissions?



### VOICE OR VIDEO SAMPLE REQUIRED



Please include a 60–90 second voice or video introduction.



Tell us:



- Your name

- Your real estate background

- Your acquisitions/closing experience

- The types of sellers you have worked with

- Why you believe you can advance seller opportunities rather than simply schedule appointments



We are looking for an experienced real estate professional who understands one important principle:



**The goal is not to force every seller into one offer. The goal is to find the right path to a transaction.**

Backup internet and backup power are strongly preferred.



## HOW TO APPLY



**We will not consider generic applications. ****



Start your application with the words:



**I CLOSE SELLER LEADS**



Then answer every question below.



### 1. SELLER EXPERIENCE



Describe your experience speaking directly with motivated U.S. property sellers.



### 2. PREVIOUS REAL ESTATE COMPANIES



What real estate companies, investors, brokerages, or acquisition teams have you worked with?



Include:



- Company name

- Dates

- Your exact role

- What YOU personally handled



### 3. CLOSER OR APPOINTMENT SETTER?



Were you personally responsible for presenting offers, negotiating price, and asking sellers to sign agreements?



Or did you primarily qualify the seller and hand the opportunity to another closer?



Be specific.



### 4. SELLER VOLUME



In an average month, approximately how many seller opportunities did YOU personally handle?



### 5. ACTUAL RESULTS



In an average month, how many of the following did YOU personally obtain?



- Signed purchase agreements

- Signed listings

- Other committed seller opportunities



**Do not include appointments, qualified leads, or opportunities passed to another closer.**



### 6. ACTUAL TRANSACTION



Walk us through **one actual seller transaction you personally handled**.



Include:



- Seller's initial asking price

- Your initial offer or recommended strategy

- Seller's main objection

- What you said or did

- Final negotiated price or outcome

- What agreement was signed

- Whether YOU personally obtained the signature



### 7. FOLLOW UP BOSS / CRM



Describe your experience with **Follow Up Boss**.



Tell us specifically which Follow Up Boss features you have personally used.



If you have not used Follow Up Boss, tell us which real estate CRM you have used instead.



### 8. SELLER PRICE OBJECTION



A homeowner tells you:



**“Zillow says my house is worth $250,000, so I'm not taking $190,000.” ****



Write exactly what you would say next as if you were actually speaking with the seller.



Do not explain your sales strategy.



### 9. REALTOR OBJECTION



A homeowner says:



**“I'm not in a hurry. I'll list it with a Realtor if I don't get my price.”**



Write exactly how you would continue the conversation.



### 10. DIFFICULT SELLER OBJECTION



Tell us about one difficult seller objection you successfully overcame.



What was the objection, what did you say or do, and what happened?



### 11. MULTIPLE SELLER SOLUTIONS



Have you ever worked for a company that could offer sellers multiple solutions such as:



- Cash purchase

- Traditional listing

- Novation

- Competitive online sale

- Auction

- Seller financing

- Another structured sale strategy



Explain.



### 12. AVAILABILITY



What hours can you consistently work in U.S. Eastern Time?



### 13. COMPENSATION



What monthly base compensation are you seeking?



## REQUIRED VOICE OR VIDEO SAMPLE



Include a link to a **60–90 second voice or video introduction**.



Tell us:



- Your name

- Your real estate seller experience

- How long you have worked with U.S. property owners

- Your acquisitions or closing experience

- Your CRM / Follow Up Boss experience

- Why you believe you can close motivated seller leads



We may not consider applications without the requested information or a voice/video sample.



We are specifically looking for someone who has already moved property-owner conversations toward **signed purchase agreements, listings, or another definitive seller commitment**.



If you are an experienced seller closer looking for a long-term role where your ability to negotiate and convert opportunities is recognized and rewarded, we want to hear from you.

title: PERFORMANCE VIDEO EDITOR — DTC / META ADS (AI-NATIVE)
description:

We're hiring one editor who is addicted to that feedback loop. Not a generalist. Not someone who "also does video."



🎬 WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO:



Cut long-form VSLs (60 sec – 5 min) built to sell, not just look pretty.

Cut UGC ads from raw creator footage — you'll get 2 takes per block and pick the one that holds.

Build hooks, captions, pattern interrupts, and pacing that get cold traffic past the 3-second wall.

Generate custom AI b-roll when stock footage is too boring (Runway, Kling, Midjourney, Higgsfield, Veo - your choice, as long as it looks real).

Ship fast variations: when something wins, we want 5 angles by end of day, same-day.

Sync ElevenLabs voiceover blocks to visuals cleanly, no drift.



✅ MUST-HAVES (no exceptions):



2+ years cutting paid ads - not weddings, not YouTube vlogs, not corporate.

Premiere Pro or After Effects at a level where the tool disappears. CapCut for speed is fine.

You think in Problem–Agitation–Solution. You know what a hook, a lead, and a close are.

AI is already in your daily workflow — generative b-roll, upscaling, generative fill, VO.

You can read a metrics dashboard and know which number to chase.

Solid written English (you'll be writing captions and reading briefs).

Fast internet and a machine that can handle AE renders.



⭐ BONUS:



Beauty / skincare / med-spa / health niche experience.

You've worked inside an ad account and seen the data yourself.

Motion graphics / kinetic typography.



🚫 THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



You need a week to deliver one cut.

"Creative" to you means more effects and transitions.

You get precious when a cut gets killed by the data.

Your entire AI stack is ChatGPT for captions.

You want stable, quiet, predictable work.



💰 WHAT YOU GET:



Long-term full-time role, paid on time, every time.

Performance bonus when your cut becomes a winner and we scale it.

We pay for your AI tools — Runway, ElevenLabs, whatever you need.

Direct line to the person making the decisions. No account managers, no 5-person approval chains.



📩 HOW TO APPLY:

Send us the single best-performing ad you've ever edited — and the number that proves it (ROAS, CTR, spend, hold rate — whatever you have).

title: AI Video Creator & Editor
description:
WHAT WE MAKE



We are a jewelry e-commerce brand. You will make all of our video content.



Mostly AI UGC with realistic people — a person on camera talking about the product. It has to be indistinguishable from real footage. Not the typical AI UGC with plastic skin and dead eyes. Not AI slop. If a viewer can tell it was generated, the video failed.



Also: ASMR unboxing, styling videos, AI talking heads, some animation. But realistic AI UGC is the core of the job.



HOW WE WORK



I give you the brief: the concept, the angle, what the video has to do. You write the prompts, run the generations, and cut the finished video.



Sometimes the brief comes with a reference video. Sometimes it does not. You work with both.



Generation and editing both matter. Generation is the harder half.



We pay for every tool and every credit. If you already have your own (CapCut Pro, Claude, an AI video subscription), that is a plus. If not, we provide them.



We are not tied to one platform. You should be comfortable switching models.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU



Experience is not optional, and I mean advanced experience. Not a few tests, not a course. Months of real work, enough that you know each model's weaknesses and have a process you can explain.



Provable experience generating AI video — Higgsfield, Veo, Sora, Kling, Runway, Hailuo. Work you made yourself.

AI people that look real. This is the skill I am hiring for. Show it.

You write your own prompts, with or without a reference video

Efficiency. Regenerating is normal; thirty attempts is not.

Strong editing: pacing, timing, sound

Fluent English, written and spoken

Flexible hours. I work in Central European Time and need you online during part of my day. Which part is negotiable.

Reliable internet and a computer that handles video work



There is no training period.



HOURS



Full-time, 40 hours minimum. If you can do 50, I want that and I pay for every hour. One person, one brand.



PAY



$5 per hour to start. About $867 per month at 40 hours.



I pay $7 for someone genuinely good. Do the trial, show me the work, and we talk.



Be realistic with yourself. If you know you cannot deliver at that level, do not apply.



Longer term, once there is trust: a fixed monthly fee for an agreed number of videos instead of hourly.



THE TRIAL — PAID



Two short test videos: one realistic AI UGC piece, one animated. I send both briefs.



I pay $25 for the two together, including credits, whether or not I hire you.



After that: a paid trial project at your full rate, then the ongoing role.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not reply here. I do not read messages or applications on this platform. I only look at the form:







No form, no consideration. Have ready:



A portfolio link with your top 10 to 15 pieces — publicly viewable, check the link first

At least one AI video with a realistic person that you made yourself. This is what I look at hardest.

One prompt you wrote yourself, in full, next to the shot it produced

The hours you can work in CET

A 60-second voice message in English



I read every completed form. I contact the people I want to move forward with.
